firstDistrictBossMechanics.representativeActionGate: for each of the three standard phases track representativeResolved=false. If a same-timestamp outgoing batch would cross that phase's lower EHP boundary before its representative action resolves, discard overflow, take the pre-batch positive threat-bucket EHP vector and scale every bucket proportionally so the rounded total is phaseGateEpsilonEhp, assigning rounding residual to the last nonempty threatBuckets-order bucket; freeze that vector and its attack-kind cycle. While clamped, later outgoing damage deals zero but incoming/events continue. At the representative action commit set representativeResolved=true and, if clamped, set every bucket to zero and enter the normal waveGapStateTransition. The gate never restores EHP and triggers at most once per phase

phaseOne.repeatSentinelRule: repeatIntervalMs=0 is the immutable one-shot sentinel: schedule supply-seizure-resolution exactly once at firstResolutionMs, resolve that event once, and schedule no successor event at the same or any later timestamp
phaseOne.effect: schedule supply-seizure-resolution itself as one enemy-caster combat event with the persistent boss actor key as source, eventTargetKey=`none`, event kind `supply-seizure`, emissionIndex 0 and its own global ID. It is non-damage, Kohaku-delayable once, and always satisfies the phase gate when it finally resolves. At resolution, if at least one live helper.runner exists, choose the oldest by helper actor key and create one nested same-timestamp helper-expiry event with that same persistent boss actor key as source, that runner actor key as eventTargetKey, event kind `forced-helper-expiry`, emissionIndex 0 and a new global ID through combatRules.helperLifecycle.combatEventIdentity. Atomically remove that runner, cancel its previously scheduled future lifetime-expiry event without reusing or advancing that cancelled ID, and do not rerun the already-passed release-helper-queue category; its slot becomes fillable at the next fixed tick. This runner branch therefore counts exactly two combat events: supply-seizure and forced-helper-expiry. Otherwise, when deliveryWorkRemainingMs is non-null, add 2000ms capped at that delivery's original required work plus 2000ms; if neither condition exists, record a resolved no-op. Either no-runner branch counts only the one supply-seizure event

phaseTwo.sourceAndDamageRule: at phase-two entry create one non-targetable persistent source key as exact ASCII `f10-crow|A` plus system.floorAttemptOrdinal zero-padded to 12 decimal digits and reset attempt.f10CrowProjectileOrdinal=0 plus an independent projectile targeting carry map. For each desired crow projectile pair increment that ordinal once and construct an immutable source-local correlation key as source key plus `|P` plus ordinal zero-padded to 12 digits. This correlation key is not a combat event ID. Every scheduled launch and impact receives its own scenario-unique event ID only through combatRules.helperLifecycle.combatEventIdentity; the paired events store the same correlation key. Classify the impact as a normal-projectile atomic enemy event. Its raw damage is curves.enemyAttack.formulaId evaluated for floor 10 with floorRoleModifiers.0.attack and event multiplier 1; then apply effectComposition.incomingAtomicDamageOrder exactly once through effectComposition.enemyProjectileDamageSnapshotRule. The source is not an actor, has no HP, cannot be targeted, and is unique across attempts while correlation keys are unique within an attempt
phaseTwo.cadenceOwnershipRule: the boss-crow cadence is independent of enemyModel.normalAttackScheduleRule, its active/staged generation, pending-normal slot and attackKindCycle cursor; creating, impacting, expiring or cancelling a crow event consumes none of them. At launch select and lock one target with enemyModel.targeting projectile weights and smooth-weighted-round-robin step using only attempt.f10CrowProjectileTargetCarry; do not read or mutate the normal projectile carry map. Phase-two end cancels the source, its pending launch/impact and its private carries after same-timestamp committed events
phaseTwo.projectileRule: schedule first desired impact at phaseTwo.firstDesiredImpactMs from phase start and use enemyModel.normalProjectileLaunchRule with enemyModel.enemyProjectileTravelMs. A committed impact applies sourceAndDamageRule to the locked living target; if that target is KO, expired or absent, legally expire for zero damage with no retarget. Either actual impact or legal target-KO expiry satisfies the representative gate and, only if phase two remains active, anchors the next desired impact by adding phaseTwo.repeatImpactIntervalMs to that actual commit timestamp. If projectile travel exceeds the desired recurrence, normalProjectileLaunchRule delays rather than backdates the successor
phaseTwo.landingWindows: for every nonnegative integer k while phase two is active, define the candidate half-open interval [5000+7000*k,7000+7000*k) ms from phase start and intersect it with the actual half-open phase-active interval [0,actualPhaseEndMs); ignore an empty intersection. Melee outgoing damage against the boss uses factor 1.0 exactly inside those clipped intervals and 0.45 otherwise; the start endpoint is included, the end endpoint and actualPhaseEndMs are excluded. Projectile outgoing damage always uses 1.0. Apply this factor exactly once in effectComposition.outgoingAtomicDamageOrder's encounter-delivery-modifier slot after skill-primary-hit and before stored charge, rally and scenario multipliers

phaseThree.entranceBlockRule: a block-start is a non-damage Kohaku-delayable enemy-non-damage-caster event; its final resolution satisfies the gate, anchors repeat cadence to that final start, and activates the block only after that timestamp's already earlier expire-statuses-and-helper-lifetimes, release-helper-queue, auto-dispatch, stored-conversion, delivery and allied-skill categories have committed. Those start-timestamp earlier actions remain legal and are never rewound. From immediately after block-start commit through timestamps strictly less than end=start+blockDurationMs, helper expiry and existing helper attacks continue but queue release and spawn are suspended; each due automatic or accepted manual request immediately advances dispatchWeightSelection and stores that selected helper request, with manual contact counted normally. At exact end, expire-statuses-and-helper-lifetimes first removes the block and replays all stored requests in original desired timestamp, then auto-before-manual, then request-key order through normal capacity/conversion rules; release-helper-queue then runs once, followed by that end timestamp's ordinary auto-dispatch. Thus the end endpoint is excluded and an end-timestamp request is never blocked
phaseThree.fireChargeRule: each non-damage Kohaku-delayable resolution arms one nonstacking phase-local charge; the next boss-heavy atomic event consumes it and applies 1.20 exactly once in incomingAtomicDamageOrder's owned-charge-multiplier slot after its boss-heavy event-class multiplier and before mitigation and shields. A later charge replaces an armed charge; phase end clears it

firstDistrictBossMechanics.phaseLifecycle: initialize the phase's relative timers and gate on entry after wave gap; carry boss actor identity, named-cat HP and legal live-helper lifetime; clear all phase-owned pending events, block requests and charges on phase exit, defeat, retry or Dawn
firstDistrictBossMechanics.sameTimestampRule: owned non-damage events are provisional under firstDistrictMechanics.lifecycleRule; direct crow impact/expiry commits in the normal projectile categories, then representative gate release is evaluated in ko-and-wave-clear before the attempt deadline

fourPhaseMechanics.phaseOneGround: use floor100FourPhase[0] threat shares, normal mixed attack-kind cadence and declared F100 heavy cadence; no extra modifier
fourPhaseMechanics.phaseTwoFlying: use floor100FourPhase[1] threat shares; flying slots are locked-target projectiles and all other combat rules remain unchanged; no hidden evasion or landing window
fourPhaseMechanics.phaseThreeShopLockdown: at phase entry suspend every shop-derived combat, healing, recovery, targeting, helper-cap/command and live-income effect, including adjacency, while retaining placements/levels and run.liveIncomeAccruedFraction. fourPhaseMechanics.phaseThreeEntryExitTimerAndCapacityTrans: on lockdown entry and exit preserve every already scheduled named-cat/helper launch, melee impact, skill, heal, rally, helper-expiry, auto-dispatch and delivery due timestamp exactly; do not rescale remaining time. Existing live helpers and queued requests remain with their actor/request identity and remaining lifetime even when their counts exceed the recomposed shop-free cap; do not expire or drop them. fourPhaseMechanics.phaseFourBerserk: at phase entry rebuild normal attack cadence from phase start using normalAttackIntervalMsInitial times phaseFourBerserkNormalIntervalMultiplier before sharedWaveAttackIntervalFormulaId; use bossHeavyFirstImpactMs unchanged for the first heavy then bossHeavyIntervalMs times phaseFourBerserkHeavyIntervalMultiplier; multiply every boss normal/projectile/heavy atomic event by phaseFourBerserkDamageMultiplier exactly once in incomingAtomicDamageOrder's phase-execution-multiplier slot after its event-class multiplier. fourPhaseMechanics.stateLifecycle: phase entry/exit is a single quantized transaction after waveGapStateTransition; cancel prior-phase pending projectiles/caster/heavy events, reset attack-kind/target cycles, retain named-cat HP and legal helper lifetime, and log every lockdown/berserk activation. autoDispatch.partyWeightAdjustments: on each request add 0.04 to guard for every selected melee-delivery named cat, 0.04 to slinger for every selected projectile-delivery named cat, and 0.04 to runner for every selected named cat whose skillKind is lowest-ratio-heal or periodic-party-heal
autoDispatch.dispatchWeightSelection: at floor-attempt start set transient carry for each helper ID to exact 0. autoDispatch.unlockedFloorAttemptRule: when profile.autoDispatchUnlocked is true and run.pendingInitialTutorialGuard=false, schedule the first ordinary automatic dispatch at floor-attempt timestamp 0 and later dispatches at effectiveIntervalFormulaId. While pendingInitialTutorialGuard=true, suppress that timestamp-0 ordinary dispatch; a passing mandatory gate materializes the sole forced guard and anchors the first ordinary dispatch one interval later
autoDispatch.manualCommandRule: select the helper through dispatchWeightSelection; spawn immediately below concurrent cap, otherwise enqueue until queueCap, and only when both live and queue caps are full apply that helper's fullQueueConversion
autoDispatch.queueRule: auto-dispatch uses the same spawn-then-enqueue-then-convert order; release the oldest queued helper immediately when a live slot opens

enemyModel.ehpDefinition: total damage required across all ordered waves or boss phases on the floor
enemyModel.relativeFloorRoleKey: String(floor % 10), except a zero remainder uses key 0
enemyModel.relativeFloorRoleApplication: enemy EHP uses hp, reward uses reward, enemy atomic damage uses attack, and the remaining encounter fields use the same role object; apply floorOverrides after the role and scenario variance last
enemyModel.waveEnemyCountAllocation: for nonboss floors use largest-remainder allocation of floorRole.enemyCount across waves weighted by waveEhpShares; ties use earlier wave; every nonempty wave receives at least one before remaining enemies are allocated
enemyModel.bossPhaseEnemyCountRule: on relative floor 0, enemyCount 1 is one persistent boss actor across every ordered phase; never allocate that count across phases
enemyModel.threatActorInterpretation: threat buckets are orthogonal damage and attack-kind shares of an aggregate wave, not disjoint enemy actors; one aggregate enemy may contribute to multiple positive buckets, while wave enemy count is allocated only across waves
enemyModel.threatShareRule: armor=floorRole.armorShare; flying=floorRole.flyingShare; neutral=1-armor-flying; reject if any share is negative or the sum differs from 1 by more than 0.000001
enemyModel.threatEhpAllocation: on nonboss waves multiply wave EHP by each final threat share; on boss phases multiply phase EHP by that phase's armor, flying and derived neutral shares; retain exact decimals until damage commitment
enemyModel.threatEnemyCountAllocation: none: never create or remove an enemy from a threat-share rounding result; use threatEhpAllocation and the wave-level alive count instead
enemyModel.normalAttackScheduleRule: at each wave or boss-phase start schedule the first desired normal impact at enemyAttackStartMs after that start, select its attack kind from the active attackKindCycleRule generation and store that immutable reserved attack kind, generation and slot on the single pending normal event. The scheduled shell is already one concrete event with source identity, eventTargetKey=`none` and a global combat event ID from combatRules.helperLifecycle.combatEventIdentity; it has no actor target before its resolution category. For melee the shell is the eventual impact event; for projectile it is the eventual launch event. When its melee impact or paired projectile impact/expiry resolves, commit all same-timestamp deltas first, consume exactly its reserved old-generation slot, then enter ko-and-wave-clear. If the wave survives, apply attackKindCycleRebuild, compute aliveEnemyCount from post-commit wave EHP and schedule the next desired impact by adding the then-current sharedWaveAttackIntervalFormulaId result to the completed event timestamp. Never schedule the successor before the rebuild decision
enemyModel.normalAttackRescheduleRule: a change in aliveEnemyCount never moves an already pending normal attack; the new count affects only the interval scheduled after the pending attack commits; a wave or phase ending cancels its pending normal and projectile events
enemyModel.normalProjectileLaunchRule: for a projectile-kind desired impact I scheduled at currentSchedulingTimestampMs, set its targetless launch-shell timestamp to maximum(currentSchedulingTimestampMs,waveOrPhaseStart,I-enemyProjectileTravelMs) and quantize launch upward. At launch resolution select and lock the target, then snapshot only the source/base/class/phase operands through effectComposition.enemyProjectileDamageSnapshotRule; do not reserve or consume an owned charge until legal impact. Create the paired impact with its own global combat event ID, the locked actor eventTargetKey and an immutable correlation key shared with the launch shell; set actual impact to launch+enemyProjectileTravelMs with rounding.derivedEventTime. A launch or impact may never be scheduled before currentSchedulingTimestampMs; when travel exceeds the desired recurrence, the event is delayed rather than backdated. For melee, set the targetless shell's actual impact to maximum(currentSchedulingTimestampMs,I) and select its damage target only when that shell resolves. Cadence always anchors the following desired impact to the actual prior impact or legal expiry commit, never the projectile launch
enemyModel.normalAttackTargetLifecycle: a pending normal melee-impact shell or projectile-launch shell uses eventTargetKey=`none`; its global ID and attack-kind reservation never change. At its final resolution category, after all earlier same-timestamp helper expiry, queue release, spawn, delivery and skill categories, select one currently living eligible actor by enemyModel.targeting smooth weighted round robin for that delivery. Store the selected actor key separately as resolvedDamageTargetKey; never rewrite the shell's eventTargetKey or global ID. A melee shell applies its atomic damage to that selected actor in the same resolution; if no eligible actor exists it legally expires for zero damage and never retargets. A projectile launch locks that selected actor and schedules its paired impact; if no eligible actor exists the launch legally expires for zero damage and schedules no impact. Same-timestamp newly spawned helpers therefore enter targeting before either selection. Wave/phase end cancels an unresolved shell or in-flight impact after already-committed same-timestamp events, without consuming a target carry step that never resolved
enemyModel.attackKindCycleRule: first allocate exactly attackKindCycleSlots integer counts from current alive threat-EHP shares by largest remainder, ties in threatBuckets order. Build the exact slot array with smooth weighted round robin: initialize carry[b]=0; for each of 20 positions add allocatedCount[b] to every carry, select the greatest carry among buckets with positive allocatedCount (tie threatBuckets order), append it, and subtract 20 from the selected carry. Flying slots are projectile; armor and neutral slots are melee
enemyModel.attackKindCycleRebuild: build the complete 20-slot active generation at wave or boss-phase start with cursor zero. In ko-and-wave-clear after same-timestamp deltas, if a threat bucket newly becomes empty and no normal event is pending, rebuild immediately from post-commit positive threat-EHP shares with cursor zero. If one normal melee, not-yet-launched projectile or in-flight projectile event is pending, never retag, move, cancel or reschedule it solely because a bucket emptied; build or replace one staged generation from the latest post-commit positive shares with cursor zero, while the pending event retains its immutable old-generation kind, target/launch rules and reserved slot. When that pending event later commits or legally expires, consume only its reserved old-generation slot, activate the newest staged generation still at cursor zero, and schedule the successor from that new generation. If the pending event itself completes in the same batch that empties a bucket, consume its old slot first and then rebuild immediately at cursor zero before scheduling its successor. A later bucket-empty commit before completion replaces the staged generation rather than stacking generations. Wave or phase end cancels pending events and discards every active or staged generation
enemyModel.projectileTargetLock: at launch resolution store the selected actor as the immutable locked target and resolvedDamageTargetKey on the paired impact, whose eventTargetKey is that actor and whose global combat event ID is distinct from the targetless launch shell. Store its source-side damage payload only through effectComposition.enemyProjectileDamageSnapshotRule. If that actor is KO, expired or absent before impact, the projectile legally expires for zero damage, never selects another target, consumes no target-side mitigation charge or shield and still completes the reserved normal slot

nonDamageCasterEvents.eligibleThreat: schedule only while the current wave or phase has positive flying threat share
nonDamageCasterEvents.effect: at resolution add 500ms to every alive projectile-delivery named cat's already pending next launch timestamp, quantize it again, and never alter a projectile already in flight
nonDamageCasterEvents.scheduleRule: schedule from wave or phase start; an interrupted event is delayed once by cat.kohaku skillResolution.backline-interrupt and later events retain their original cadence from the prior event's final resolved timestamp; cancel at wave or phase end

firstDistrictWaveRosters.authorityRule: for absolute F1-F10 these rosters are the sole visual actor and firstDistrictMechanics ownership map; expand counts and allocate entity EHP only through firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation. Per-wave counts must equal waveEnemyCountAllocation, except the same persistent F10 boss is repeated only to describe phases. F8 wave 3 alone replaces the matrix with exact namedObjectiveWaveEntities EHP. Numeric wave EHP, threat shares and attack scaling remain floorRole/floorOverride authority; a count or matrix-sum mismatch is fatal

firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation.instanceExpansion: within each wave expand roster entries in listed order and each entry's count into instances numbered from 1; instance key is canonical enemy ID plus `|W` plus one-based wave zero-padded 2 plus `|I` plus global expanded instance ordinal zero-padded 3
firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation.matrixAllocation: outside F8 named wave 3 and F10 boss phases, for each threat bucket allocate that wave's exact bucket EHP equally across all expanded instances using roundSixDecimals for instances 1 through N-1 and exact nonnegative residual for instance N. An instance's current EHP is the sum of its three cells; wave bucket EHP is the sum of that bucket's instance cells
firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation.targetSelection: an outgoing actor first selects the first globally nonempty threat bucket in its targetPriority, then the lowest expanded instance ordinal with positive EHP in that bucket, except an explicit named-objective/focus rule may replace only the instance choice. Commit damage to that one matrix cell and the identical aggregate bucket once; damage overflow is discarded
firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation.koRule: an instance is KO only when all three of its matrix cells are zero after a same-timestamp commit; its owned timers cancel then. Multiple instance KOs at one timestamp are simultaneous and ordered only for logs by instance key. Wave clear occurs when all matrix cells are zero
firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation.f8NamedException: F8 wave 3 uses floorOverrides.8.namedObjectiveWaveEntities total EHP shares and each entity's declared single threat instead of matrixAllocation; namedObjectiveTargetRule and strict objective timestamps apply
firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation.f10BossException: F10 is one persistent boss actor; its phase threat buckets are not split into instances
firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation.invariant: after every commit, each cell and entity EHP is nonnegative and the sum of entity cells per bucket equals aggregate current bucket EHP within 0.000001; otherwise fail

firstDistrictMechanics.enemy.ash_mouse: no special event; use the normal attack schedule and targeting exactly
firstDistrictMechanics.enemy.soot_weasel: reset a wave-local committed-normal-melee counter to 0; every third committed normal melee owned by a wave containing soot_weasel targets the living named cat with lowest frontlineShare, then lowest currentHp/maxHp ratio, then canonical ID. A forced event neither reads nor mutates the normal melee smooth-WRR carry map; the next unforced melee resumes from its prior carries. Projectile and heavy events do not advance the counter
firstDistrictMechanics.enemy.sack_mole: in a non-named first-district wave whose roster contains sack_mole, its mitigation owns the entire aggregate armor bucket: use factor 0.65 for named-cat/helper melee primary damage to that bucket and 0.90 for projectile primary damage. Apply that factor exactly once in effectComposition.outgoingAtomicDamageOrder's encounter-delivery-modifier slot after skill-primary-hit and before stored charge, rally and scenario multipliers. In F8 named wave 3 it applies only when the exact target is enemy.sack_mole, not encounter.d01.wall. armament.breaker replaces this mole factor with 1.0. Secondary damage derives from the resulting primary
firstDistrictMechanics.enemy.scrap_crow: owns no extra timer; its flying threat slots use the normal locked-target enemy projectile rule and its outgoing flying EHP remains susceptible to projectile-delivery cats
firstDistrictMechanics.enemy.smoke_bat: while a wave containing smoke_bat is active schedule smoke at 3500ms then every 5500ms from the prior final resolution; on resolution add 300ms to every alive projectile-delivery named cat/helper pending next launch, quantize upward, never alter an in-flight projectile, never delay one launch more than once per smoke event, and cancel all pending smoke at wave end or last smoke_bat EHP reaching zero
firstDistrictMechanics.enemy.spark_gecko: while a wave containing spark_gecko is active schedule a charge at 4500ms then every 7000ms; resolution arms one nonstacking wave-local charge, and the next committed enemy normal melee/projectile or elite-heavy atomic damage event consumes it and uses 1.35 exactly once in incomingAtomicDamageOrder's owned-charge-multiplier slot after the event-class multiplier; a new charge replaces one already armed and wave/gecko defeat clears it
firstDistrictMechanics.elite.ledger_owl: outside F8, schedule at 4000ms then every 7000ms; if deliveryWorkRemainingMs is non-null add 750ms capped at its current delivery's original required work plus 1500ms, otherwise do nothing; Kohaku may delay each event once and owl KO cancels pending/future events. F8 uses floorOverrides.8.reinforcementReservation instead
firstDistrictMechanics.elite.blackwing_guard: each elite-heavy impact also applies one 600ms retarget/contact delay to every living named cat and helper's next launch or melee impact, using maximum(existing timestamp,impact+600ms); it never moves an in-flight projectile and does not stack more than once for the same heavy event
firstDistrictMechanics.encounter.d01.wall: has no attack timer; it is the named armor blocker EHP at F8 and receives sack_mole's delivery mitigation only when the exact selected target is enemy.sack_mole, never by sharing the armor bucket
firstDistrictMechanics.boss.d01.kagetsubasa: use floorOverrides.10.firstDistrictBossMechanics in addition to standardThreePhase heavy cadence
firstDistrictMechanics.lifecycleRule: outside F8 named wave 3, an owned mechanic exists while at least one instance of that canonical enemy ID has positive firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation matrix EHP; each instance owns its own timer/counter unless the mechanic explicitly says wave-local, and the last owning-instance KO cancels future shared events. F8 named ownership follows exact named EHP; F10 follows the persistent boss phase. Wave/phase end cancels every pending owned event and clears all owned counters/charges. Same-timestamp owned caster effects are provisional until commit-same-timestamp-deltas and are discarded when outgoing deltas KO the last legal owner at that timestamp

targeting.smoothWeightedRoundRobinStep: derive every eligible actor weight with its delivery formula and roundSixDecimals; set totalWeight=roundSixDecimals(sum rounded eligible weights). In canonical named-cat ID then helper actor-key order set each carriedWeight=roundSixDecimalsSigned(oldCarry+roundedWeight), select the greatest exact rounded carriedWeight using that same key order as tie-break, then set only selected carriedWeight=roundSixDecimalsSigned(selectedCarriedWeight-totalWeight). Retain all six-decimal signed carries until wave reset; binary floating-point residues and unrounded comparisons are forbidden. A named cat's actor key is its canonical ID
targeting.carryMembershipLifecycle: a helper spawned or released mid-wave enters each applicable targeting carry map at 0; an actor that expires or becomes KO is removed and its carry is discarded; other carries are not renormalized; a revived or newly spawned actor always re-enters at 0
targeting.heavyTarget: alive actor with greatest frontlineShare, then greatest current-HP ratio, then canonical ID, then helper actor key
targeting.heavyTargetLockRule: at emit-heavy-telegraphs select heavyTarget from the committed state and persist that exact actor key on the telegraph and its paired impact; do not recompute at impact. If that actor is alive at impact, apply the atomic heavy event to it; if it is KO, expired or absent, expire the heavy for zero damage with no retarget and no shield or one-hit counter consumption. The impact-or-legal-expiry still resolves any first-clear representative-action gate owned by that heavy
targeting.eligibleActors: selected named cats and live helpers

enemyModel.heavyScheduleRule: on absolute F1-F10, schedule elite-heavy telegraph/impact events only in a wave whose roster has positive-EHP eliteHeavyFirstDistrictOwner: F8 wave 2 and the selected F9 guard variant wave 1; owner KO cancels pending/future elite heavies. On absolute F11-F99, relative floor 8 schedules the abstract elite-heavy cadence for each wave. Relative floor 0 schedules boss-heavy events for each boss phase. First impact and interval fields are desired impact timestamps measured from owning wave/phase start, and each telegraph occurs its declared duration before impact
enemyModel.bossPhaseOverrideRule: every relative-floor-0 encounter except floor 100 uses standardThreePhase; floor 100 uses floor100FourPhase; each phase is one state of the same persistent boss actor, carries named-cat HP and live-helper remaining lifetime, and resets targeting and enemy attack cycles after clockModel.waveGapMs

genericFirstClearBossPhaseGate.scope: active while the current X0 boss canonical ID is absent from profile.firstClearedBossIds at floor-attempt start; every retry remains gated until that boss clear is committed. F10 uses floorOverrides.10.firstDistrictBossMechanics.representativeActionGate instead. F20 through F90 use standardThreePhaseRepresentatives and F100 uses floor100FourPhaseRepresentatives. A later re-clear after the boss ID is present has no representative gate
standardThreePhaseRepresentatives: phase-2 first normal enemy projectile impact-or-legal-locked-target-expiry
floor100FourPhaseRepresentatives: phase-2 first normal enemy projectile impact-or-legal-locked-target-expiry
genericFirstClearBossPhaseGate.projectileRepresentativeScheduling: when a representative requires a normal enemy projectile, schedule the first projectile slot from the phase attackKindCycleRule; legal locked-target expiry resolves it. If no eligible actor exists before launch, the attempt has already failed and the gate does not manufacture an event
genericFirstClearBossPhaseGate.clampAndRelease: for each phase set representativeResolved=false on entry. If a same-timestamp outgoing batch would cross the phase lower EHP boundary first, discard overflow, scale the pre-batch positive threat-bucket EHP vector proportionally to phaseGateEpsilonEhp after roundSixDecimals and assign rounding residual to the last nonempty threatBuckets-order bucket; freeze that vector and its attack-kind cycle. Later outgoing damage is zero while clamped, but incoming events continue. At representative action impact, legal expiry or immediate entry transaction set representativeResolved=true and, if clamped, set every bucket to zero before normal waveGapStateTransition. The gate restores no EHP, grants no reward, and triggers at most once per phase
genericFirstClearBossPhaseGate.sameTimestampRule: commit the representative action in its normal simultaneousEventOrder category; evaluate gate release during ko-and-wave-clear after all same-timestamp deltas and before resolve-attempt-deadline. A phase-entry representative commits before that phase schedules or resolves any outgoing combat event

combatRules.floorAttemptStart: after the stable floor-entry party and armament selection, increment scenario-lifetime system.floorAttemptOrdinal by one; reset run.helperRequestOrdinal, run.helperSpawnOrdinal and run.combatEventOrdinal to 0. Preserve run.pendingInitialTutorialGuard across a failed first-tutorial attempt and its retry; every other initial, clear, Dawn or ordinary entry uses its already authoritative false value. On initial game or Dawn reset, selected named cats start at full HP. On defeat retry, preserve exactly the HP prepared by retryState and partySelectionHpTransaction, including retryFullHealFraction below 1; floorAttemptStart must not overwrite it to full. After a prior clear, use floorClearRecovery. For every initial entry and retry, set wave/phase index to 1 and construct the current floor's authoritative full initial wave-1 enemy state from enemyModel/floor override rules using the new attempt ordinal: all entity and backing-bucket EHP, persistent boss phase-1 bucket cells, selected F9 variant, mechanic owners, representative gate, attack-kind generation/cursor, target carries, counters, charges and pending enemy events begin at their declared initial values. No failed wave/phase index, enemy EHP, target, owner, counter, generation or pending event carries into the new attempt. Live helpers and queues are empty, attack and skill timers start at zero, and all three transient helper dispatch-weight carries start at zero. Capture the immutable attempt-start snapshot and run survival.mandatoryOneHitGateTiming before scheduling the first combat event or materializing the pending tutorial guard
combatRules.floorClearRecovery: apply exactly once as the second floorClearCommitOrder step, immediately after final combat/objective deltas and before reward, unlock, choice, reconfiguration or purchase changes maximum HP. Set survivorRecoveryFraction=roundSixDecimals(minimum(floorClearSurvivorHealMaximumWithShop,floorClearSurvivorHealMaxHpFraction+the already aggregated legal pre-clear shop recovery)). For each surviving selected named cat set requestedHeal=roundSixDecimals(its pre-post-clear maximumHp*survivorRecoveryFraction), then currentHp=roundSixDecimals(minimum(maximumHp,oldCurrentHp+requestedHeal)). For each KO selected named cat set currentHp=roundSixDecimals(clamp(pre-post-clear maximumHp*floorClearKoReviveMaxHpFraction,0,maximumHp)). Then remove all helpers, projectiles, shields, queues, storedHelperConversionCharges and temporary statuses. This special recovery never enters healingOrder. Later maximum-HP mutations use maximumHpMutationRule and never reapply recovery
combatRules.retryState: only after combatRules.failureBoundaryOrder has completed the defeat presentation, preserve coins including presentation live income, purchases, unlocks, selected relics, run.deliveryCount, run.deliveryWorkRemainingMs and run.pendingInitialTutorialGuard exactly; for each selected named cat set currentHp=roundSixDecimals(clamp(then-current maximumHp*retryFullHealFraction,0,then-current maximumHp)), then clear helpers, queues, projectiles, shields, statuses, every allied and enemy combat timer, all enemy entities/buckets/EHP, current wave/phase, target carries, mechanic owners, charges, counters, attack-kind generations/gates and attempt-local F8 reinforcement state including pending-arrival reservations. Never clear or restart persistent support delivery work. If pendingInitialTutorialGuard=true, helperRequestOrdinal, helperSpawnOrdinal and combatEventOrdinal remain zero until a later retry's mandatory one-hit gate passes. This preparation itself grants no reward, performs no purchase and writes no persisted revision; the later first accepted non-Dawn concrete change authorizes a new floorAttemptStart, which always reconstructs authoritative wave/phase 1 at full initial enemy EHP, while an executed Dawn uses its own reset and starts no retry of the old run
combatRules.failureBoundaryOrder: after the same-timestamp damage/KO/deadline batch marks an attempt failed, schedule no further combat event. Freeze and retain the exact final attempt log and attempt-start snapshot; select diagnosis IDs, update same-cause signature/count and record the suggestion context. Then run exactly defeatPresentationMs of foreground time with combat, helper, delivery-work, cooldown, transition, purchase and Dawn clocks paused; only shopModel.liveIncomeAccrual advances, and no purchase evaluation is triggered during the presentation. After it ends, apply retryState once, then visit decisionPolicies.failure.concreteChangeEvaluationOrder against the updated coins and clean retry state. When the first category yields a legal concrete suggestion, apply failureAchievementCommit. For purchase, party, armament or shop, reevaluate that same category from the new revision, commit at most its declared change and stop later categories. If the suggestion belongs to either Dawn category, restart the Dawn suffix at progress-Dawn and then zero-gain-recovery-Dawn from the new reward ledger, execute the first newly legal Dawn and never return to a pre-Dawn category; if neither is legal, terminate noLegalConcreteChange. A non-Dawn commit immediately starts one new attempt, an executed Dawn ends the old run without retry, and no legal category terminates noLegalConcreteChange. A t=0 mandatory one-hit rejection enters this same order with zero combat elapsed and zero combat events
combatRules.waveStart: carry named-cat HP and live-helper remaining lifetime from the previous wave; at the end of the wave gap apply Toto wave heal and nap-inn wave recovery once to living named cats, deriving each base-heal and all multipliers only through effectComposition.healingAtomicRule and capping through healingCapacityReservation, then reset target and enemy attack cycles
combatRules.waveGapStateTransition: at wave clear cancel every pending incoming or outgoing projectile and enemy damage/caster event from the cleared wave; during the quantized clockModel.waveGapMs continue foreground live-income accrual, delivery work, helper lifetimes, queue release and dispatch, and resolve or latch skills only through waveGapSkillLifecycle, but emit no attack or enemy event. Attack cooldown timestamps continue to elapse and become ready; at next wave start each ready actor must still wait its effectiveContactTravelMs before its first launch or melee impact, while a not-yet-ready actor uses maximum(its carried due timestamp,waveStart+effectiveContactTravelMs). Helper and named-cat HP are never globally refilled
combatRules.waveGapSkillLifecycle: skillCategoryMapping is exhaustive in a wave gap. arm-defensive-skills and resolve-healing keep their due timestamps, resolve at each due foreground fixed tick in their declared category, and anchor the next interval to that actual commit. resolve-control-and-rally-skills do not fire without an active wave: when one or more intervals become due, latch exactly one ready state per source and skill, bank no additional activations, and discard their obsolete due timestamps. On the first active fixed tick after next-wave initialization, release each latched activation exactly once in resolve-control-and-rally-skills using controlAndRallySkillOrderRule; this release sees the newly scheduled enemy normal slot and current live helpers, and anchors its next interval to that release commit. impact-owned skills have no independent gap clock and change only on their declared committed attack impacts. Wave gap, hide/resume and helper expiry preserve or remove these states by source identity; an expired or KO source loses its latch
combatRules.floorClearReward: award curves.enemyReward once after the last wave; repeated attempts award zero until a new run re-clears the floor
combatRules.floorAttemptStartEffectivePowerSnapshot: before the first combat event, evaluate effectComposition.effectivePowerScalar against this floor's final threat/phase composition and store it on the attempt; retries replace the attempt snapshot but never overwrite an existing profile first-clear record
combatRules.floorClearUSnapshotRule: immediately after update-run-and-profile-highest-floor and before any first-time delay, choice, reconfiguration, utility preview or post-clear purchase, evaluate offline.uIndex.snapshotCommitRule from the staged new profile.highestReachedFloor and current profile.rewardingDawnCount and store the complete snapshot in the post-clear transaction draft. Every later decision and purchase in this boundary reads exactly that staged clampedU; no prior snapshot is legal. A purchase that commits during the boundary carries forward or identically recomputes the same complete snapshot. The final complete post-clear boundary persists it even when no purchase commits, so profile.lastPersistedUSnapshot.highestReachedFloor equals the newly committed highest floor and profile.lastPersistedU equals its clampedU. F100 uses the same prefix rule before its terminal success latch
combatRules.postBossBoundaryOrder: after the final boss damage/KO commit, apply floorClearRecovery exactly once, then finish reward and highest-floor writes, stage the complete new-highest U snapshot through floorClearUSnapshotRule, and finish first-boss, tier, support/shop unlock and district-seal/Dawn-unlock writes; run the required first-time district-result delay while the pre-reconfiguration live-income rate remains active; commit any deterministic first-time action and cat/achievement checks; open the current-run free reconfiguration period and evaluate at most one free transition; run the purchase policy to its fixed point against the resulting placement and staged U. All of those operations obey clockModel.postClearDraftRevisionRule, so their economy counts/logs remain distinct but they expose no individual revision; persist the complete post-clear boundary in one revision. Only then create and synchronously evaluate exactly one post-clear Dawn checkpoint. If Dawn executes, its own later atomic revision resets the run and cancels transition; otherwise transition to the next district. The old post-clear boundary is never persisted again after Dawn. No free reconfiguration, purchase or Dawn recommendation may occur before the required delay, no second recovery occurs, and no second purchase loop follows the Dawn checkpoint. continuousFirstTen rejects Dawn consent and stops after the persisted F10 boundary/checkpoint but before transition, so its timing includes the F10 disclosure without observing a half-committed unlock/ledger state
combatRules.floor100TerminalOverride: on F100 execute the core prefix through final deltas, the one floorClearRecovery, mandatory floor reward with its one economy count, highest-floor, first-clear power, boss/achievement ledger and complete uIndex snapshot persistence, then latch stopPolicy success and completion timestamp. The override skips only the generic suffix and does not exempt the final combat batch or reward from their atomic count preflights. Do not run the generic required-decision delay, free shop reconfiguration, post-clear purchase policy, Dawn checkpoint, run reset or floor transition; postgame S09 is presentation-only. This override precedes and replaces the suffix of floorClearCommitOrder
combatRules.floorClearProgressCounterCommit: set run.foregroundStagnationMs, run.sameCauseDefeatCount to 0 and run.lastDefeatCauseSignature to null; if run.armamentLockRemainingClears is positive decrement it by exactly one after this floor's equipped family has finished affecting combat
combatRules.catchupExpirationCommit: after updating profile.highestReachedFloor, if run.activeCatchupForMaximumFloor is non-null and the new profile maximum is greater than it, set run.activeCatchupForMaximumFloor to null before any next-floor power evaluation
combatRules.firstClearEffectivePowerRecord: if profile.recordedFirstClearEffectivePowerByFloor has no key for the cleared floor, store the successful attempt's floorAttemptStartEffectivePowerSnapshot; the value is immutable thereafter and must be finite and positive
combatRules.bossFirstClearCommit: on first clear of a relative-floor-0 boss, map the floor to districtProgression.districts.bossId and atomically add it to profile.firstClearedBossIds before tier, district-seal, Dawn-unlock and reward-ledger eligibility are evaluated
combatRules.achievementCommit: when a dawn.rewardLedger achievement trigger becomes true, atomically add its registered sourceAchievementId to profile.completedAchievementIds once; Dawn eligibility reads that set
combatRules.nextFloorCommit: after a clear below floor 100 set run.currentFloor to the cleared floor plus 1 after the quantized floor transition; F100 uses floor100TerminalOverride, keeps currentFloor at 100 and never synthesizes floor 101
combatRules.namedCatAttackStart: first launch or melee impact is effectiveContactTravelMs plus the actor's composed attack interval; later launches or melee impacts repeat the composed attack interval from the preceding launch or melee impact unless retargetTravelRule delays them
combatRules.effectiveContactTravelRule: for a named cat, initial-contact travel is clamp(contactTravelMs,clockModel.catContactTravelMs.range[0],clockModel.catContactTravelMs.range[1]) with no ranged or observatory reduction; for a helper use clamp(clockModel.catContactTravelMs.initial,the same range); for retarget only, set deliveryBaseMs to that clamped initial value times rangedContactTravelMultiplier for projectile delivery and the clamped initial value for melee, then multiply by 1-minimum(targetingLossReductionCap,sum of active targetingLossReductionPerLevel effects); apply rounding.derivedEventTime
combatRules.retargetTravelRule: apply only through alliedPrimaryTargetLifecycleRule. When an actor's actorFocusTargetKey becomes empty or an encounter rule forces a different priority, clear that focus and delay its already-scheduled targetless next launch/melee shell in place to maximum(existingDueTimestamp,targetChangeTimestamp+effectiveContactTravelMs); retain that shell's global event ID and eventTargetKey=`none`. A focus change does not reset attack or skill-hit counters except where skillResolution explicitly says so
combatRules.rangedImpactRule: apply only through alliedPrimaryTargetLifecycleRule and effectComposition.projectileDamageSnapshotRule. A projectile-launch shell chooses and locks the exact threat bucket plus entity at launch, snapshots its declared source damage state, then creates one distinct paired impact global event ID for launch timestamp plus projectileTravelMs. If the locked target is empty before impact, the projectile legally expires for zero damage, never retargets, and increments no hit or skill-hit counter; melee selects and commits at its targetless shell's resolution timestamp
combatRules.alliedPrimaryTargetLifecycleRule: at wave/phase entry every living named cat and each subsequently spawned helper has actorFocusTargetKey=`none`; schedule its first and every later melee-impact or projectile-launch shell as a concrete targetless event with eventTargetKey=`none`, immutable source/delivery/kind/due timestamp and one global combat event ID. A pending shell stores no damage target. At the shell's normal simultaneousEventOrder category, sort shells by source actor key then global event ID and make every selection from the same immutable pre-commit enemy EHP snapshot; reservations or damage from another same-timestamp allied shell cannot change a selection, so legal overkill is possible. If the actor's existing non-none focus is still positive and still legal under namedObjectiveTargetRule and outgoingTargetRule, retain it; otherwise choose the exact primary bucket/entity through those rules, set actorFocusTargetKey to it, and store it only as resolvedDamageTargetKey for this resolution. Never rewrite the shell ID or targetless eventTargetKey. A melee shell applies one atomic event to that resolved target; a projectile-launch shell creates one separately identified impact carrying the immutable locked target and correlation key. If no legal target exists, the shell legally expires for zero damage, clears focus, creates no impact and increments no hit/skill counter, while its next cadence still anchors to that expiry. When retargetTravelRule observes a focus becoming empty before a pending shell, delay that same targetless shell without reissuing its ID; an already launched projectile remains locked. Wave/phase end cancels pending shells and in-flight impacts only after already-committed same-timestamp events. This rule is the sole allied primary target, focus, shell-identity and retarget owner
combatRules.alliedKoLifecycle: after commit-same-timestamp-deltas, an allied actor whose currentHp is zero is KO. Events already included in that same atomic timestamp still resolve from the pre-commit state; cancel every future unlaunched melee impact, projectile launch, skill, heal, rally, defensive arm and status event owned by that actor, and discard its shields, finite charges and targeting carries. A projectile already launched by that actor remains in flight and later impacts or legally expires against its locked target even if the source is KO. A named cat remains selected but inactive until floorClearRecovery, retry or Dawn. Remove a KO helper from the live set during ko-and-wave-clear; its slot becomes eligible only at the next fixed tick's release-helper-queue category, never in the KO tick
combatRules.helperAttackStart: first launch or melee impact is spawn timestamp plus effectiveContactTravelRule's clamped helper initial-contact travel plus the helper's composed attack interval after every active attackSpeedPerLevel effect and the attackIntervalMinimumMs clamp; later launches or melee impacts repeat that composed interval from the preceding launch or melee impact

helperLifecycle.expiryTimestamp: spawn timestamp plus lifetimeMs, quantized by rounding.derivedEventTime
helperLifecycle.queueRelease: after expiry processing, fill open live slots from the oldest queued helper, preserving queued order; a helper KO at the later damage commit opens a slot only on the next fixed tick
helperLifecycle.autoDispatch: after expiry and queue release, each due automatic event applies helperBaselines.autoDispatch.manualCommandRule and therefore advances the adaptive dispatch-weight carries exactly once
helperLifecycle.manualDispatch: clockModel.accept-player-input runs after the combat tick; each accepted command first passes stopPolicy.playerInputCombatLimitPreflightRule, then applies manualCommandRule exactly once and a spawned helper cannot attack before its future helperAttackStart. If that accepted command directly spawns helper.guard while its stored conversion charge is one, consume the charge and arm the shield on that exact new actor inside the same input transaction; queued guards consume only when later released during a fixed tick
helperLifecycle.helperRequestAndActorIdentity: increment run.helperRequestOrdinal for every auto or manual helper request and use `request|A`+system.floorAttemptOrdinal zero-padded 8+`|`+request ordinal zero-padded 8 as the queue key; when a helper actually spawns increment run.helperSpawnOrdinal and use helper canonical ID+`|A`+system.floorAttemptOrdinal zero-padded 8+`|spawn|`+spawn ordinal zero-padded 8 as its actor key; queued requests receive no actor key until spawn
helperLifecycle.helperSpawnHealth: at every direct spawn or queue release create the helper with currentHp equal to its then-composed maximumHp and no inherited damage, shield, status, cooldown or finite charge; only a stored helper.guard conversion resolved later in that fixed tick, or the explicit manualDispatch same-input transaction, may arm the declared guard shield
helperLifecycle.enemyActorIdentity: an F1-F9 roster instance uses firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation.instanceExpansion key plus `|F` absolute floor zero-padded 3 plus `|A` system.floorAttemptOrdinal zero-padded 8; an F8 named wave-3 entity uses its canonical ID plus the same F/A suffix plus `|W03`; an F10 or later boss uses its persistent boss canonical ID plus F/A plus `|boss`, unchanged across phases; an F11-F99 nonboss aggregate uses `enemy|F` plus floor zero-padded 3 plus `|A` plus attempt zero-padded 8 plus `|W` plus wave zero-padded 2
helperLifecycle.waveNormalAttackSourceIdentity: the one aggregate normal melee/projectile stream on every nonboss wave uses `wave-normal|F`+absolute floor zero-padded 3+`|A`+attempt zero-padded 8+`|W`+wave zero-padded 2, independent of which roster instance remains. Its cadence scales through aliveEnemyCount; instance KO never transfers or duplicates the stream. Boss normal streams use the persistent boss actor key
helperLifecycle.nonActorSourceIdentity: use `system|A`+attempt zero-padded 8 as base. Append `|deadline` for attempt deadline, `|ko` for every koEventIdentityRule event, `|W`+wave zero-padded 2+`|transition` for wave/phase transitions, `|auto-dispatch` for automatic request events, `|delivery|`+support canonical ID for delivery progress/arrival, and `|input` for accepted manual commands. A generic flying caster on a nonboss wave uses waveNormalAttackSourceIdentity+`|caster|generic-flying`; on an X0 boss phase it uses the persistent boss actor key+`|caster|generic-flying|P`+phase one-based zero-padded 2 and is canceled at that phase end. A first-district owned caster uses its exact owner actor key+`|caster|`+mechanic kind. A status expiry uses owner actor key+`|status|`+status kind; a telegraph uses owning enemy actor key+`|telegraph|`+heavy kind. A shop/support/relic-originated heal, recovery or passive event uses `effect|`+canonical source ID+`|F`+floor zero-padded 3+`|A`+attempt zero-padded 8, and a per-placement shop additionally appends `|P`+placement floor zero-padded 3. No empty/fallback source key is legal; every producer must match one construction before scheduling
helperLifecycle.eventTargetKey: named-cat/helper targets use exact actor key; named-entity targets use enemyActorIdentity; aggregate EHP uses `bucket|` plus threat bucket; party-wide events use `party`; a targetless event uses exact nonempty sentinel `none`. Every pending enemy normal or allied primary melee shell/projectile-launch shell uses `none` because target selection occurs at resolution; its later resolvedDamageTargetKey is a separate field and never rewrites identity. The empty string is forbidden
helperLifecycle.combatEventIdentity: whenever concrete events are scheduled from one source timestamp, sort all new events by simultaneousEventOrder category, source actor key, eventTargetKey, event kind, then a declared zero-based emission index for genuinely repeated identical source/target/kind events; increment run.combatEventOrdinal once per event and assign `event|A`+system.floorAttemptOrdinal zero-padded 8+`|`+combat-event ordinal zero-padded 10. A targetless pending enemy normal or allied primary melee shell/projectile-launch shell is a concrete scheduled event and receives its immutable ID with eventTargetKey=`none`; its paired projectile impact receives a separate ID only when launch resolves. Container iteration order is forbidden; the assigned key is scenario-unique, persisted in the event and used as final tie-break
helperLifecycle.fullQueueConversionCommit: when live and queue caps are both full, consume no helper slot and set run.storedHelperConversionCharges for that helper ID to one; a new command while already one replaces rather than stacks the charge
helperLifecycle.storedChargeOwnershipAndPersistence: charges belong to the helper ID key, persist across waves and foreground/background boundaries within the current floor attempt, and are cleared on floor clear, defeat, retry initialization and Dawn
helperLifecycle.guardChargeConsumption: for auto spawn or queue release, at resolve-stored-helper-conversions consume one helper.guard charge only when a helper.guard spawned earlier in that same fixed tick; for a direct manual spawn consume inside manualDispatch on that exact guard. In either path give only that actor a shield equal to shopModel.commandPowerComposition.guard times its composed maximum HP for the declared duration. One spawn consumes at most one charge and a charge can never skip an earlier eligible guard
helperLifecycle.guardConversionShieldState: store shieldRemainingHp and shieldExpiresAtMs on that exact guard actor; initialize or reapply to maximum(existing remaining,roundSixDecimals(composed guard maximum HP*shopModel.commandPowerComposition.guard)) without adding, and set expiry to current timestamp plus durationMs; after incomingAtomicDamageOrder has clamped the composed multiplier and rounded the atomic damage once, absorb minimum(shieldRemainingHp,post-mitigation atomic damage), subtract it from the shield, pass exact excess to actor HP without a second rounding, and discard any remaining shield on expiry, helper KO or helper expiry
helperLifecycle.slingerChargeConsumption: consume one helper.slinger charge at the next outgoing projectile launch by any live helper.slinger, snapshot shopModel.commandPowerComposition.slinger into that projectile's immutable correlation state, and apply that stored-projectile-charge slot exactly once at its impact. A later helper-rally state neither replaces nor re-snapshots this charge
helperLifecycle.runnerChargeConsumption: at resolve-stored-helper-conversions, first evaluate shopModel.commandPowerComposition.runner to its roundSixDecimals result. If deliveryWorkRemainingMs is non-null consume one helper.runner charge and write deliveryWorkRemainingMs=roundSixDecimals(maximum(0,old deliveryWorkRemainingMs*runner result)) exactly once; if null retain the charge
helperLifecycle.sameTickDeliveryContributorRule: helper expiry and queue release occur before delivery work; a runner expiring this tick contributes zero, a runner released or auto-spawned this tick contributes, and a runner manually spawned after the tick first contributes on the next fixed step

combatRules.outgoingTargetRule: each actor attacks the first nonempty threat bucket in its targetPriority; damage uses its attackMultiplierByThreat and the selected armament multiplier for that bucket
combatRules.namedObjectiveTargetRule: on F8 wave 3, use floorOverrides.8.namedObjectiveAllocationRule as the sole EHP state and initialize immutable attempt.f8NamedTargetMode=ledger-first at wave entry. While elite.ledger_owl has positive EHP, every primary attack actor with a positive multiplier for its flying threat targets that exact entity before every other named entity regardless of actor targetPriority; an actor unable to damage flying follows normal targetPriority and listed order. After the ledger owl reaches zero, all primary attacks use targetPriority then namedObjectiveWaveEntities listed order among positive-EHP entities. The mode never invokes a prediction, reference trace or recursive target comparison, never changes before ledger KO and never overrides secondaryTargetRule; emit objectiveSuccessEventId only if the objective reaches zero before every other named entity
combatRules.secondaryTargetRule: after an impact-owned skill chooses the first positive-EHP threat bucket other than its locked primary bucket by that source's targetPriority, do not reapply namedObjectiveTargetRule or any primary focus. Lock exactly one secondary target from the same pre-commit state: on F1-F9 ordinary matrix waves choose the lowest expanded instance ordinal with positive EHP in the secondary bucket; on F8 named wave 3 choose the first floorOverrides.8.namedObjectiveWaveEntities listed entity whose declared threat is that bucket and whose EHP is positive; on any boss choose the same persistent boss actor's secondary bucket cell; on later aggregate waves choose that aggregate bucket. Store that entity/bucket key on the secondary event, never retarget it, subtract its no-overflow damage once from the entity cell when present and once from the identical aggregate bucket bookkeeping view, and discard excess. If no legal secondary bucket/target exists, consume the trigger with no secondary event
combatRules.skillTimerScheduleRule: at floor-attempt local t=0 initialize elapsed=0 for every selected named-cat interval skill and set firstDueMs=rounding.derivedEventTime(intervalMs), never t=0. After each actual resolution commit, including a legal no-op, set nextDueMs=rounding.derivedEventTime(actualCommitMs+intervalMs). During a wave gap use waveGapSkillLifecycle instead: defensive/healing commits keep this cadence, while control/rally coalesces to one latch and anchors the next due time to its next-wave release commit. Hide/resume preserves exact due/latch state. Named-cat KO cancels its timer and latch for the rest of the attempt; retry and Dawn clear all timers before the next floorAttemptStart
combatRules.controlAndRallySkillOrderRule: inside resolve-control-and-rally-skills, sort all due triggers by source cat canonical ID then global combat event ID and apply their timer/status/event-schedule mutations sequentially in that order; a later trigger reads the earlier trigger's updated pending-event and rally state. The entire category resolves before every heavy telegraph, allied/enemy attack launch or impact and enemy caster category at the same timestamp

skillResolution.timersReset: use combatRules.skillTimerScheduleRule at floor-attempt start; wave changes do not reset skill timers and wave-gap behavior is owned only by combatRules.waveGapSkillLifecycle unless the skill says its impact-owned target state resets
skillResolution.shield-next-heavy-hit: every intervalMs arm one charge up to one; consume it on the next elite or boss heavy atomic event targeting Mugi and multiply that event by 1-damageReductionInitial
skillResolution.consecutive-targeting: for consecutive hits on the same threat bucket use 1 + (maximumDamageMultiplierInitial-1) * (min(consecutiveHit, hitsToMaximum)-1)/(hitsToMaximum-1). Before each committed impact, reset the counter exactly when the bucket emptied, the target changed, or currentImpactMs-priorCommittedImpactMs is strictly greater than targetResetGapMs; equality does not reset. After that test increment consecutiveHit for the current impact and evaluate the multiplier
skillResolution.lowest-ratio-heal: every healIntervalMs select the alive named cat with lowest current/max HP ratio, tie canonical ID, evaluate cat.toto.skill.healFormulaId at Toto's exact current level, and pass that one rounded result as base-heal through effectComposition.healingAtomicRule. After each nonfinal wave, for every alive named cat evaluate roundSixDecimals(target maximumHp*waveHealMaxHpFractionInitial) as base-heal and pass it through healingAtomicRule once
skillResolution.backline-interrupt: every intervalMs resolve in resolve-control-and-rally-skills before enemy-non-damage-caster-events. Select the pending not-previously-interrupted non-damage caster with earliest final due timestamp, including one already due at the current timestamp; tie by source actor key, eventTargetKey using exact `none` for a targetless caster, then global combat event ID. Add enemyAttackSuppressionSecondsInitial*1000 milliseconds, quantize upward by rounding.derivedEventTime, and mark that event interrupted; never delay direct damage, an already committed event or one event twice
skillResolution.armor-break-every-fifth-hit: each fifth outgoing hit multiplies that hit by cycleHitDamageMultiplier and resets the counter
skillResolution.periodic-party-heal: every intervalMs for each alive named cat evaluate roundSixDecimals(source cat maximumHp*healOwnMaxHpFraction) as base-heal, pass it through effectComposition.healingAtomicRule once, and cap only through combatRules.healingCapacityReservation
skillResolution.slow-next-enemy-event: every intervalMs resolve in resolve-control-and-rally-skills before enemy normal melee impacts and enemy projectile launches. Choose the earliest not-previously-slowed pending targetless enemy normal melee-impact shell or projectile-launch shell, including one already due at the current timestamp; tie by final due timestamp, simultaneousEventOrder category, source actor key, eventTargetKey exact `none`, then global combat event ID. Never select a heavy, caster event or already-launched projectile impact. Add delayMs to the chosen shell and quantize upward; a delayed launch creates its paired impact only when the delayed launch resolves, so projectileTravelMs remains exact. Mark that reserved attack slot as slowed so no later use can delay it again, and anchor the following normal attack slot to this final delayed melee resolution or later projectile impact/expiry. If no eligible event exists, commit a no-op without banking the delay
skillResolution.flying-chain-hit: reset a source-cat counter to zero at floor-attempt start and carry it across waves. Increment only on a committed primary projectile impact whose exact primary threat bucket is flying; launches, melee, projectile expiry and secondary hits do not count. On each everyAttackCount-th such hit, reset the counter to zero, choose and lock the secondary bucket/entity only through combatRules.secondaryTargetRule, and deal secondaryDamageFraction of the final primary damage through effectComposition.secondaryDamageRule as a separate no-overflow atomic event. If none exists, consume the trigger with no secondary damage
skillResolution.frontline-guard: every intervalMs arm protectedHitCount charges up to protectedHitCount; choose the protected actor by enemyModel.targeting.heavyTarget restricted to living selected named cats (greatest frontlineShare, then greatest current-HP ratio, then canonical ID), and each atomic event against that exact actor consumes one and is multiplied by 1-damageReduction; recompute the protected actor immediately before finite-charge reservation for each timestamp
skillResolution.helper-rally: every intervalMs resolve in resolve-control-and-rally-skills before helper melee impacts, outgoing projectile launches and outgoing projectile impacts. Activate the multiplier at the current timestamp, so every live-helper melee or projectile impact due at that same timestamp uses it, including a projectile launched earlier; refresh duration without stacking
skillResolution.low-ehp-execute: multiply outgoing damage by damageMultiplier when the current target bucket is at or below thresholdFraction of its initial EHP
skillResolution.boss-phase-focus: multiply the source cat's damage by bossDamageMultiplier on X0 floors and normalDamageMultiplier otherwise

combatRules.attemptDeadlineRule: schedule the deadline at exactly enemyModel.failureTimeLimitSeconds*1000 from floor-attempt start; same-timestamp damage, KO and final wave-clear resolve first, so an atomic final clear committed at exactly 90000ms succeeds; if positive final enemy EHP remains after ko-and-wave-clear at that timestamp, resolve-attempt-deadline fails the attempt
combatRules.healingCapacityReservation: inside resolve-healing sort events by target canonical ID, source actor key and unique event ID; initialize each target's missing-HP capacity to maximumHp-currentHp from the pre-commit state, reserve minimum(requestedHeal,remainingCapacity) for each event, decrement that temporary capacity, and sum only reserved heals into the later HP delta; damage is then subtracted from currentHp plus reserved healing, while shields absorb post-mitigation damage independently and are never refilled by healing
combatRules.finiteChargeAndCounterReservation: inside each simultaneousEventOrder category sort events by source canonical ID, source actor key, then unique event ID; before calculating deltas, walk that order and reserve or consume each finite shield, guard, slinger charge and hit counter at most once, updating a temporary resource ledger after every event; later events see that ledger, while all HP and EHP reads remain from the pre-commit state
combatRules.positiveEhpDeltaReservation: after outgoing damage sums are known, evaluate each provisional positive-EHP event's owner-survival predicate against preCommit owner EHP minus its summed same-timestamp outgoing damage. Discard a failed event entirely. For a surviving F8 reinforcement arrival, calculate its one roundSixDecimals reservedRestore only from preCommit reserve-target missing EHP; then commit namedTargetEhp=clamp(preCommitNamedTargetEhp+reservedRestore-summedOutgoingDamageToNamedTarget,0,targetInitialEhp) and backingArmorEhp=clamp(preCommitBackingArmorEhp+reservedRestore-summedOutgoingDamageToArmorBucket,0,initialWaveArmorEhp). The identical damage assigned to that named armor target appears once in each bookkeeping view, not twice in either view; add reservedRestore once to each view to preserve firstDistrictEntityEhpAllocation.invariant. A target at zero pre-commit may revive only when this net result is positive. No positive-EHP event uses post-damage missing capacity or transfers damage overflow
combatRules.sameTimestampDamageCommit: after finiteChargeAndCounterReservation, calculate every listed atomic event modifier against pre-commit HP and EHP plus its reserved resource state, sum reserved healing and damage per actor and outgoing damage per exact named entity/threat bucket, evaluate provisional owner survival and reserve positive EHP only through positiveEhpDeltaReservation, then atomically set actor currentHp=clamp(preCommitHp+reservedHealing-summedDamage,0,maximumHp), ordinary target EHP=maximum(0,preCommitEhp-summedOutgoingDamage), and any F8 reinforced named target/backing bucket by positiveEhpDeltaReservation's exact equations; damage overflow never transfers. Commit the temporary charge/counter ledger and successful-arrival side effects next, generate every allowed zero-transition KO exactly through koEventIdentityRule, then resolve outcome only through mutualZeroResolutionRule before the attempt deadline; every damage event retains a unique event ID for one-hit tests
combatRules.mutualZeroResolutionRule: inside ko-and-wave-clear inspect the one atomic post-commit snapshot. First derive selectedCatsAllKo and whether the current enemy wave/phase/final-floor state reached exact zero. survival.successRule remains authoritative: if selectedCatsAllKo is true, attempt failure wins even when enemy EHP also became zero in that batch. In that mutual-zero case commit allied KO events and any ordinary nonterminal enemy-instance KO events already implied by their positive-to-zero transitions, but do not latch wave clear, phase transition, final boss KO, floor clear, reward, recovery or F100 success; cancel the would-be clear suffix and enter failureBoundaryOrder before resolve-attempt-deadline. If at least one selected named cat remains alive, resolve a zero enemy state normally, with an atomic final clear at exactly the deadline winning before resolve-attempt-deadline. If enemy EHP remains positive and all selected cats are KO, fail normally. This rule applies identically to nonfinal waves, boss phases, final waves and F100 and permits no draw state
combatRules.koEventIdentityRule: inside ko-and-wave-clear compare pre-commit and post-commit state and generate exactly one event kind `ko` for each eligible positive-to-zero transition: each selected named-cat actor; each live helper actor; each ordinary F1-F9 expanded enemy instance whose complete matrix-cell sum becomes zero; each F8 named entity whose EHP becomes zero; and each F11-F99 nonboss aggregate wave target whose total wave EHP becomes zero. A threat bucket reaching zero generates no KO. Every relative-floor-0 persistent boss at F10,F20,...,F100 generates one KO only when its total EHP reaches zero in its final phase and mutualZeroResolutionRule authorizes the floor terminal clear; an earlier phase boundary generates only its normal phase-transition event. Use source actor key `system|A`+attempt zero-padded 8+`|ko`; use the exact named-cat/helper actor key, enemyActorIdentity, or for a later aggregate exact `wave-target|F`+floor zero-padded 3+`|A`+attempt zero-padded 8+`|W`+wave zero-padded 2 as eventTargetKey. For an allied KO, store immutable provenanceDamageEventIds as the ascending global-ID list of every same-commit atomic damage event targeting that actor whose exact reserved post-mitigation and post-shield actor-HP contribution is strictly positive under finiteChargeAndCounterReservation. For an enemy KO, include every same-commit outgoing atomic event whose requested final rounded damage is strictly positive and whose locked exact entity/bucket had positive pre-commit EHP; do not allocate the target's capped EHP among simultaneous events and do not exclude an overkilling event. A healing event is never provenance. Collect all newly derived KO events, sort by eventTargetKey then event kind with emission index 0, and assign global IDs through helperLifecycle.combatEventIdentity in the ko-and-wave-clear category. The provenance IDs are never reused as KO source or ID. Across an attempt, the first selected named-cat KO is the earliest KO timestamp, then lowest KO global event ID, then canonical actor key; its projectile predicate is true iff provenanceDamageEventIds contains at least one event whose immutable delivery kind is enemy-projectile. Revived zero-to-positive, already-zero and phase-only transitions generate no KO
combatRules.partySelection: reevaluate only after a cat unlock, Dawn, or defeat; enumerate legal parties up to partyMaximumNamedCats, require at least one actor whose frontlineShare is at least partyRequiredFrontlineShareThreshold when one is unlocked, and rank only through partySelectionEvaluationRule
combatRules.partySelectionEvaluationRule: at a stable pre-attempt checkpoint clone the identical preselection state once per legal canonical-ID party, apply partySelectionHpTransaction to that clone, and evaluate effectComposition.effectivePowerScalar and effectComposition.survivalMarginScalar only through effectComposition.effectivePowerReferenceTrace with identical keyed draws. Set explicit comparisonFloor=min(100,clearedFloor+1) for a cat unlock committed after clear, comparisonFloor=1 after Dawn, and comparisonFloor=the failed run.currentFloor after defeat; never infer the cat-unlock floor from the still-old run.currentFloor. Reject the scenario if either scalar is non-finite. Rank greatest effectivePowerScalar, then greatest survivalMarginScalar, then lexicographically smallest canonical-ID list. A survival pass means survival.oneHitCheck passes for every selected actor/class at this exact clone and survivalMarginScalar>0; otherwise it fails. Freeze current-party and candidate-party scalar/pass results before any selection mutation
combatRules.partySelectionHpTransaction: at a non-Dawn reevaluation, cats retained in the selected list keep exact current HP after effectComposition.maximumHpMutationRule, a newly selected or newly unlocked cat enters at full composed maximum HP, and a removed cat has no active combat HP; Dawn uses dawn.reset.party and starts every selected cat full; clear all selected-cat contact, attack and skill timers and apply floorAttemptStart before the next retry or floor, never mid-wave
combatRules.recommendedBandSnapshot: the exact state produced by the tested persona, schedule, build and purchase policy without debug grants

shopModel.duplicateOrdinal: one-based count of the same shop ID in ascending placement-floor order
shopModel.placementFloorRewardOperandRule: for each run.shopPlacements entry whose immutable absolute placement floor is p, derive roleKey=String(p % 10) except remainder zero uses `0`; set composedRewardModifier=floorRoleModifiers[roleKey].reward times floorOverrides[String(p)].reward when that optional numeric reward multiplier exists, otherwise times 1. Evaluate curves.enemyReward.formulaId exactly once with runtime.floor=p and runtime.floorRoleModifier=composedRewardModifier, and use that resulting exact nonnegative integer as runtime.placementFloorReward for this placement's shop-level nextCostFormulaId and liveIncomeFormulaId and for a reconfiguration targeting this placement. Recompute the same deterministic operand after Dawn blueprint restoration and after reconfiguration; never use run.currentFloor, the latest cleared floor, a placement-time snapshot, scenario execution variance or first-clear status. The placement floor p and resulting operand do not change when the shop family changes
shopModel.liveIncomeAccrual: on every complete clockModel.fixedStepMs while document is visible and simulation is running—including combat, wave gaps, floor transitions, mandatory first-time decisions and defeat presentation—use clockModel.foregroundFixedStepIncomeCommitRule's left-endpoint composed per-placement liveIncomeFormulaId snapshot, evaluate liveIncomeAccrualFormulaId with run.liveIncomeAccruedFraction, atomically add creditedWholeCoins to run.coins and retain retainedFraction before the right-endpoint event/boundary; do not run a purchase evaluation merely because a coin was credited; do not accrue during offline/background and never reset the fraction when the rate changes or a floor changes
shopModel.continuousEffectCapRule: apply shopStatComposition in its declared order. For every continuous PerLevel field except liveIncomePerLevel, compute each placement contribution once with levelEffectFormulaId, sum that field across placements, and apply only its declared fieldSpecificCap if present. Project those field totals into each targetStatFields list, sum the listed fields, clamp that target-stat sum once to maximumAdditiveBonusPerStatFromAllShops, and apply exactly one 1+targetStatBonus multiplier at the single shop-additive-bonus slot; armor uses the armored target group instead of also applying its nonarmor group. Never cap each uncapped input field separately. Never multiply reinforcementPowerPerLevel, helperPowerPerLevel, effectiveDpsPerLevel and allEffectivePowerPerLevel as separate helper-power multipliers. specialChannelRules are excluded from target-stat projection and execute exactly once by their named rule. liveIncomePerLevel is placement-local and follows its exact special rule before placement income is summed

shopStatComposition.fieldAggregationRule: for each listed PerLevel field, evaluate formulaRules.algorithmDefinitions[levelEffectFormulaId] once for each placement that declares it, sum those rounded placement contributions, then apply the fieldSpecificCaps entry when present; a field absent from fieldSpecificCaps remains uncapped until target-stat composition or its special-channel rule
shopStatComposition.targetStatRule: for one requested target stat, sum exactly its targetStatFields field totals after fieldSpecificCaps, clamp that sum once to shopModel.maximumAdditiveBonusPerStatFromAllShops, and consume it once. Outgoing and maximum-HP groups apply one 1+bonus multiplier at effectComposition's single shop-additive-bonus slot; healing applies one 1+bonus multiplier; attackSpeed divides the pre-shop interval by 1+bonus and then clamps once to effectComposition.attackIntervalMinimumMs. Never combine an armored and nonarmor outgoing group for one hit

specialChannelRules.recoveryPerLevel: add aggregate once to /combatRules/floorClearSurvivorHealMaxHpFraction and cap total at /combatRules/floorClearSurvivorHealMaximumWithShop
specialChannelRules.enemyAttackSuppressionPerLevel: aggregate once and cap at /shopModel/shops/shop.lantern-store/suppressionCap before one subtraction
specialChannelRules.helperCapAtLevels: sum discrete reached-threshold slots once and cap at /helperBaselines/autoDispatch/maximumUpgradedConcurrentCap

adjacency.linkMultiplierApplicationRule: for each run.shopPlacements entry at commercial floor p, inspect every other current placement exactly once and set differentAdjacentShopTypeCount and sameAdjacentShopTypeCount from entries whose absolute floor difference from p equals commercialSlotsAreAdjacentWhenFloorDifference, classifying equal shop IDs as same and unequal IDs as different. Set activeSupportLinkCount from districtProgression support-activation entries whose floor is in run.clearedFloorsThisRun and whose absolute floor difference from p equals supportLinkWhenFloorDifference. Reject counts above their declared maxima, evaluate placementLinkMultiplierFormulaId once from those three counts, and pass that exact scalar once to liveIncomeFormulaId and once to each continuous levelEffectFormulaId contribution. Recompute after placement, reconfiguration, support activation, known-floor blueprint restoration or Dawn reset; do not apply it to discrete thresholds
