adjacency.discreteThresholdRule: duplicate factors and adjacency/support-link multipliers never alter helperCapAtLevels or any other integer threshold grant; each placement contributes exactly one concurrent slot at each reached listed level before the global integer cap

selection.candidateSet: all shops unlocked at the placement timestamp
selection.ties: earlier rank in the selected build's shopPreference array, then canonical shop ID; an unlisted shop has rank positive infinity
selection.commit: atomically append or replace the run.shopPlacements entry keyed by the exact commercial floor with the selected shop ID at placement level 0, append or replace the same floor/shop pair in profile.retainedShopBlueprint, recompute effects, immediately commit achievement.first-shop-synergy if its trigger becomes true, and log before and after. Inside floorClearCommitOrder stage all fields and the economy count under clockModel.postClearDraftRevisionRule with no individual stateRevision increment; at a standalone stable checkpoint use one compare-and-swap and increment system.stateRevision exactly once

effectChannelSemantics.reinforcementPowerPerLevel: contribute to the exact helper outgoing and maximum-HP target groups in shopStatComposition.targetStatFields; do not form its own multiplier
effectChannelSemantics.helperCapAtLevels: each placement adds one concurrent helper slot when its integer level reaches each listed threshold; total cap is clamped to helperBaselines.autoDispatch.maximumUpgradedConcurrentCap
effectChannelSemantics.catDamagePerLevel: contribute to the exact named-cat outgoing target groups in shopStatComposition.targetStatFields
effectChannelSemantics.armoredEffectBonusPerLevel: contribute only to named-cat and helper armored outgoing target groups, never their nonarmor groups
effectChannelSemantics.helperPowerPerLevel: contribute to the exact helper outgoing and maximum-HP target groups in shopStatComposition.targetStatFields; do not form its own multiplier
effectChannelSemantics.commandPowerPerLevel: set commandPowerBonus=minimum(shopModel.commandPowerComposition.commandPowerBonusCap,sum of effective commandPowerPerLevel contributions after duplicate and link multipliers), then apply shopModel.commandPowerComposition; durations and stored-charge caps do not change
effectChannelSemantics.recoveryPerLevel: add the aggregated contribution once to combatRules.floorClearSurvivorHealMaxHpFraction and cap the total at combatRules.floorClearSurvivorHealMaximumWithShop
effectChannelSemantics.liveIncomePerLevel: this channel is placement-local, never pooled across placements. For each placement that declares liveIncomePerLevel, evaluate levelEffectFormulaId for that same placement, clamp only that returned additive contribution to shopModel.maximumAdditiveBonusPerStatFromAllShops, then multiply this placement's already link-composed liveIncomeFormulaId result by 1 plus the clamped local contribution. A placement without this field uses only its liveIncomeFormulaId result. Sum all resulting placement incomes only after those local multipliers; duplicateFactor and placementLinkMultiplier are already inside the two formula results and must not be applied again
effectChannelSemantics.offlineIncomePerLevel: sum effective per-level contributions from every delivery-warehouse placement after duplicate factors, then clamp that one aggregate sum to the single shop.delivery-warehouse.offlineIncomeShopCap before composing the offline commerce multiplier
effectChannelSemantics.effectiveDpsPerLevel: contribute to the exact named-cat and helper outgoing target groups in shopStatComposition.targetStatFields; do not form its own multiplier
effectChannelSemantics.targetingLossReductionPerLevel: reduce ranged contact and retarget downtime fraction, never below zero, with the aggregate capped at combatRules.targetingLossReductionCap
effectChannelSemantics.enemyAttackSuppressionPerLevel: subtract once from enemy event damage multiplier after the aggregate is capped at shopModel.shops.shop.lantern-store.suppressionCap
effectChannelSemantics.waveRecoveryPerLevel: heal each living named cat once between nonfinal waves by the aggregated max-HP fraction capped at shopModel.shops.shop.nap-inn.waveRecoveryCap
effectChannelSemantics.allEffectivePowerPerLevel: first cap its aggregated field total at shopModel.shops.shop.curio-gallery.allEffectivePowerCap, then contribute that one total to the four declared outgoing and maximum-HP target groups; do not form its own multiplier

supportModel.activationRule: first clear of each districtProgression support activation floor increments that support ID's run.supportActivationLevels value by one; Dawn resets the four-key map and known-floor re-clear activates entries again. deliveryWorkRequiredMs and deliveryWorkRemainingMs are six-decimal work units under support.supply-lift.deliveryWorkUnitRule. On the first supply-lift activation initialize null deliveryWorkRemainingMs to the new roundSixDecimals deliveryWorkRequiredMs; on a later supply-lift activation preserve fractional progress by setting newRemainingMs=roundSixDecimals(newRequiredMs*clamp(oldRemainingMs/oldRequiredMs,0,1))
supportModel.effectChannelSemantics: for every numeric field ending PerActivation, compute fieldBonus=roundSixDecimals(minimum(the matching Cap field,run.supportActivationLevels[supportId]*PerActivation)); missing or negative levels are fatal. For a target stat, add all eligible support fieldBonus values and apply exactly one multiplier 1+sum in effectComposition's support-additive-bonus slot; never compound activations or facilities separately. support.training-ground.catDamage maps only to named-cat outgoing primary damage. support.rest-nest.catHp maps only to named-cat maximum HP and invokes maximumHpMutationRule when activation changes it; its healing maps to every healingAtomicRule event. support.request-board.helperPower maps to both helper outgoing primary damage and helper maximum HP. support.supply-lift.liveIncome maps to foreground live income after placement contributions and before relic/dawn multipliers; offlineIncome maps to offline commerceMultiplierSnapshot before relic/dawn multipliers; deliveryIntervalReduction maps only to deliveryWorkRequiredMs and is not an income or power bonus. Boolean disclosure fields create no numeric effect. Each numeric support effect field has exactly these consumers and no others
supportModel.firstDistrictScriptedDelivery: only on the profile's first-ever clear of F3, synchronously inside apply-support-shop-and-armament-unlocks immediately after supply-lift activation and before any required first-time delay or districtProgression.catUnlockCheckpoint, commit exactly three scripted delivery arrivals, increment run.deliveryCount by 3, leave deliveryWorkRemainingMs at the newly initialized full requirement, and count three combat events but no elapsed time or coin reward. Give all three source actor key `system|A`+attempt zero-padded 8+`|delivery|support.supply-lift`, eventTargetKey=`none` and event kind `delivery-arrival`; in scripted commit order assign emissionIndex exactly 0,1,2 and a distinct global ID through combatRules.helperLifecycle.combatEventIdentity. No fixed step or ordinary delivery-work progress may interleave between activation and this scripted transaction; later runs and later supply-lift activations do not replay it

support.supply-lift.deliveryWorkUnitRule: deliveryWorkRequiredMs and run.deliveryWorkRemainingMs use six-decimal delivery-work units despite the legacy Ms suffix; one work unit equals one base millisecond. They are not clock timestamps, delays or durations and are the sole exception named by rounding.timeInternalMilliseconds
support.supply-lift.deliveryWorkProgress: at progress-support-delivery-work-and-commit-arrivals on each eligible foreground fixed step, first set workDelta=roundSixDecimals(clockModel.fixedStepMs * helper.runner.deliverySpeedMultiplierWhileAlive^liveRunnerCount), then set remaining=roundSixDecimalsSigned(oldRemaining-workDelta). Eligible phases are active combat, wave gap and floor transition only. Pause delivery work during every mandatory first-time or later blocking decision, defeat presentation, other blocking menu, offline interval, stopped scenario and bounded decision projection even though foreground live income may advance. While remaining<=0, atomically increment run.deliveryCount by one and set remaining=roundSixDecimalsSigned(remaining+current roundSixDecimals deliveryWorkRequiredMs), permitting multiple arrivals and treating exact zero as an arrival boundary. Let N be the number of arrivals produced by this one loop; create exactly N delivery-arrival events in loop commit order with source actor key `system|A`+attempt zero-padded 8+`|delivery|support.supply-lift`, eventTargetKey=`none`, event kind `delivery-arrival` and zero-based emissionIndex 0 through N-1, and assign each global ID through combatRules.helperLifecycle.combatEventIdentity. After the loop require remaining>0 and persist that exact six-decimal remainder; a nonpositive required work value or non-finite result fails. A delivery arrival commits before the deferred catUnlockCheckpoint and never directly changes the party
support.supply-lift.fullQueueRunnerConversion: for one consumed stored charge use commandPowerComposition.runner's already computed roundSixDecimals result and write deliveryWorkRemainingMs=roundSixDecimals(maximum(0,old deliveryWorkRemainingMs*runner result)) exactly once

relicModel.selectedInstanceShape: each run.selectedRelicInstances entry is exactly {familyId:canonical relic ID,sourceFloor:absolute X9 integer,ordinalWithinFamily:one-based integer}; sourceFloor is unique in the current run and ordinalWithinFamily equals the ascending-sourceFloor count of that family after commit
relicModel.selectionCommit: after the required choice append one selectedInstanceShape entry, recompute every family ordinal in ascending sourceFloor, then allow entry to X0; Dawn clears the array. Inside floorClearCommitOrder this is a staged choice under clockModel.postClearDraftRevisionRule with no individual stateRevision increment; a standalone required choice owns one compare-and-swap
relicModel.selectionPolicy: evaluate every candidate with effectComposition.boundedDecisionProjectionProcedure and effectComposition.choiceScoreRule. If one or more candidates have a finite score strictly greater than 0, rank only that positive set by greatest score, then greatest candidate effectivePowerScalar minus control effectivePowerScalar, then canonical relic ID. If no score is positive, rank every finite candidate by the identical three keys and commit the greatest even when nonpositive because the choice is mandatory. If no finite candidate exists, fail the scenario. Canonical ID is never compared before score or effective-power delta
relicModel.effectChannelSemantics: for each family use effectComposition.relicStackComposition to compute one roundSixDecimals familyBonus=sum(base effect field*stackFactorsByOrdinal[ordinalWithinFamily-1]) in ascending sourceFloor order; reject an invalid ordinal or excess instance. Apply exactly one multiplier 1+familyBonus in the relic-additive-bonus slot and never multiply individual instances. relic.soot-clearing-claw.catDamage maps only to named-cat outgoing primary damage. relic.resonant-bell.helperPower maps to both helper outgoing primary damage and helper maximum HP, invoking maximumHpMutationRule when acquisition changes a living helper's maximum. relic.warm-delivery-box.liveAndOfflineIncome maps once to foreground live income and once to offline commerceMultiplierSnapshot in their respective calculations. Relics do not affect named-cat HP, healing, enemy damage, delivery work or any other channel

rewardLedger.achievementCommitBoundaryRule: commit source achievement IDs at their actual trigger transaction before any later same-timestamp Dawn eligibility check: first-defeat-diagnosis after diagnosis plus one legal suggestion; first-armament-switch only after a wave or retry fully resolves as a successful wave clear while run.equippedArmament equals run.pendingArmamentSwitchAchievementFamily, then clear that pending field; and first-shop-synergy immediately after placement or reconfiguration recomputes links. A failed or interrupted wave never commits the switch achievement and leaves the pending family until it clears a wave or is replaced by a later accepted family change; floorClearCommitOrder is only an additional checkpoint and never the sole source

dawn.nodeCostIndexRule: buying current level L to L+1 costs nodeCostsByLevel[L] for L from 0 through 4

branchSpendPolicy.buyPreferredNodeWhileAffordable: starting from its current level, repeatedly buy exactly the next primary-branch node while below maximumBranchLevel and its exact nodeCostIndexRule cost is affordable; commit and deduct after each node, never skip a level, then continue to secondary loop only after the primary is capped
branchSpendPolicy.afterPrimaryCapChooseHighestMarginalEffe: under clockModel.diagnosticHorizonClockRule, at each secondary-loop iteration take one identical current post-award/post-respec/pre-node source state for every candidate; clone it, apply exactly that candidate node and shard deduction, execute every remaining Dawn transaction after branch spending including the complete run reset and catch-up/ledger writes, and only then run one exact standard 86400-second schedule from F1 and zero run coins with the same keyed scenario draws while disabling further Dawn, respec and branch spending. The diagnostic must complete all 86400000ms wall and 720000ms foreground regardless of authoritative scenario time or floor-attempt budget already consumed. If atomic F100 success latches earlier, apply secondaryBranchEarlyTerminalRule. Otherwise, at the final offline return score only a clone whose complete return/settlement/disabled-Dawn/context-validation fixed point needs zero positive foreground time and leaves no pending event, frozen context or transaction draft; assign every other candidate a non-finite marginal score, never extend the schedule and never score a pre-return or partially settled state. Evaluate starting effectivePowerScalar immediately after that clone's reset and ending effectivePowerScalar after the valid settled or early-terminal-padded schedule against the same announced pre-Dawn frontier; maximize natural log(ending/starting) divided by exact shard cost, then canonical branch ID. Never project from the pre-reset high-floor run or its coins
branchSpendPolicy.secondaryBranchEarlyTerminalRule: this rule applies only when the secondary-branch standard-schedule diagnostic atomically latches valid F100 success before diagnosticElapsedWallMs=86400000. Capture the byte-exact terminal gameplay snapshot and its original completion timestamp immediately after stopPolicy.floor100TerminalRule, requiring pendingOfflineEvent=null, frozenForegroundContext=null and transactionDraft=null. Freeze all run, profile and system fields including system.monotonicClockMs, system.foregroundClockMs, coins, U snapshots, levels, HP, event queue, counters, ordinals, stateRevision and completion metrics at that latch; schedule and mutate no event, hide, return, settlement, income, purchase, Dawn, transition or postgame action. Traverse the remainder of returnSchedules.standard only as type-aware padding: add each remaining declared foreground millisecond to diagnosticElapsedWallMs and diagnosticElapsedForegroundMs, and each remaining offline millisecond only to diagnosticElapsedWallMs, including the unconsumed suffix of the segment containing the latch, until they equal exactly 86400000 and 720000. This padding is not simulation time, does not alter the frozen F100 completion timestamp or source, and is the sole diagnostic exception to stopPolicy.floor100TerminalRule. Score a finite ending effectivePowerScalar from the frozen terminal gameplay snapshot at the exact diagnostic horizon; do not invoke the secondary final-offline return rule after terminal success
branchSpendPolicy.secondaryLoopRule: after the primary is capped, while-loop: enumerate exactly the next node of every below-cap non-primary branch whose exact cost is affordable from current shards; evaluate every candidate from the same current source via afterPrimaryCapChooseHighestMarginalEffectivePower; reject a non-finite score or a score <=0; commit and deduct exactly one highest-ranked node; then rebuild clones and recompute all candidates from the new state. Stop with shards unspent when no positive affordable node remains or all branches are capped

dawn.combat.composition: sum gains through owned level, then multiply named-cat outgoing damage by 1+sum

dawn.reinforcement.composition: sum gains through owned level, then multiply helper attack and maximum HP by 1+sum

dawn.commerce.composition: sum gains through owned level, then multiply live and offline income before the offline commerce cap by 1+sum

reset.catLevels: all profile-unlocked cats return to level 1
reset.party: inside the one atomic Dawn reset, first stage every non-party reset field in this reset object plus reward IDs, any free respec, post-spend branch levels, district seals, restored armament tier/family, the evaluated activeCatchupForMaximumFloor result and all Dawn ledger increments. The evaluation source is that exact staged post-reset state: catLevels for every profile-unlocked cat are 1, helperLevel=0, coins=0, shopPlacements and selectedRelicInstances are empty, all supportActivationLevels are 0, no live helper/combat state exists, and no pre-Dawn cat level, shop, relic, support, coins, party or HP is visible. Against all profile-unlocked cats run combatRules.partySelectionEvaluationRule exactly once with explicit comparisonFloor=1; for every candidate party assign full composed maximum HP from that staged state before its reference trace, including the newly staged branch/seal/catch-up effects. Commit that one selected party at full maximum HP as select-post-reset-party. No post-reset caller may select the party again
reset.shopBlueprintRestoration: retain profile.retainedShopBlueprint but restore its exact shop ID at level 0 only when that commercial floor is re-cleared, using districtProgression.commercialSlotRule without running placement selection; no blueprint effect is active before that floor
reset.equippedArmament: retain the prior equipped family when profile-unlocked, otherwise use weapons.automaticInitialEquipAtUnlock when available, otherwise null
reset.postExecutionF1EntryRule: after the atomic Dawn reset has already selected the F1 party exactly once, do not rerun party selection. Evaluate decisionPolicies.armament exactly once for F1 under routine rules with no F4 tutorial exemption, commit any accepted family change by its normal standalone rule, then call combatRules.floorAttemptStart for F1 exactly once. Create no additional floor-entry Dawn checkpoint in this Dawn exit suffix
reset.pendingArmamentSwitchAchievementFamily: if achievement.first-armament-switch is not complete and the prior pending family equals the retained equippedArmament, retain that exact family across Dawn so its first successful new-run wave can commit the achievement; otherwise null
reset.committedEconomyCount: preserve exact scenario-lifetime system.committedEconomyCount; Dawn never resets it
reset.committedCombatEventCount: preserve exact scenario-lifetime system.committedCombatEventCount; Dawn never resets it
reset.combatState: clear helpers, queues, projectiles, shields, statuses, enemy state and all combat timers
reset.activeCatchupForMaximumFloor: set to the pre-Dawn highestReachedFloor only when sameMaximumCatchup is eligible, otherwise null
reset.unlistedRunFieldPolicy: reset to the initialState.run value or fail if no initial value or explicit rule exists
reset.lastDawnMaximumFloorTransaction: compute same-maximum status from the pre-Dawn profile.lastDawnMaximumFloor, apply catch-up eligibility, then atomically replace it with the Dawn transaction's highestReachedFloor
reset.zeroGainRecoveryFloorLedgerTransaction: a zero-gain recovery Dawn atomically adds highestReachedFloor to profile.zeroGainRecoveryDawnHighestFloors; membership blocks all later zero-gain recovery Dawn at that maximum
reset.rewardingDawnCountIncrement: 1 only when newRewardIds is nonempty; otherwise 0

sameMaximumCatchup.eligibility: pre-Dawn profile.highestReachedFloor is positive and exactly equals pre-Dawn profile.lastDawnMaximumFloor; an already active catch-up is replaced, never multiplied
sameMaximumCatchup.applicationTransaction: during dawn.reset set run.activeCatchupForMaximumFloor to the pre-Dawn highestReachedFloor only when eligibility is true; effectComposition.sameMaximumCatchupMultiplier is its sole combat consumer and combatRules.catchupExpirationCommit is its sole early expiration
sameMaximumCatchup.freeRespecTransaction: once during an eligible Dawn, refund to profile.dawnShards the exact sum of dawn.nodeCostsByLevel indexes 0 through ownedLevel-1 across all three branch levels, atomically set all three levels to 0, then run dawn.branchSpendPolicy using the scenario build's primary branch; claimed reward IDs, completed counts and every other profile field are unchanged by the refund, and no shard is created or destroyed

decisionPolicy.evaluationSchedule: create a logically distinct checkpoint after each of: (1) an offline settlement and its purchase loop, (2) the complete post-clear boundary sequence before transition, (3) floor-entry party/armament selection before wave start, (4) a defeat only when failure.shortCircuitRetryTransaction reaches a Dawn category, and (5) the first fixed step at which foregroundStagnationMs crosses its threshold after that tick's damage/KO/deadline result. At creation increment system.dawnEvaluationCheckpointOrdinal exactly once, evaluate that ordinal exactly once even when system.stateRevision is unchanged, and store it in system.lastDawnEvaluationCheckpointOrdinal; previews never increment either field. If checkpoints share a timestamp, process them in the numbered order but do not collapse them by revision. At each checkpoint test progressDawnExecutionRule before zeroGainRecoveryExecutionRule and execute at most one Dawn; an executed Dawn ends the old-run boundary and cancels any not-yet-created old-run checkpoint
decisionPolicy.comparisonFloorRule: for every Dawn preview, trigger and projection set comparisonFloor=min(100,profile.highestReachedFloor+1) from the stable checkpoint state and pass that explicit floor to every effectComposition reference trace. Never infer it from run.currentFloor. F100 success creates no Dawn checkpoint, so the clamped 100 case is diagnostic only
decisionPolicy.predictedTtkSamplingRule: at the selected checkpoint evaluate effectComposition.predictedTtkSecondsDefinition against decisionPolicy.comparisonFloorRule and the exact post-purchase/post-loadout state; previews do not mutate ledgers or ordinals, and a mid-attempt stagnation Dawn cancels the attempt before the next fixed step with no floor reward
decisionPolicy.foregroundStagnationLifecycle: run.foregroundStagnationMs starts at 0 and increments by clockModel.fixedStepMs only during visible active frontier combat, where frontier means run.currentFloor=profile.highestReachedFloor+1; it pauses during defeatPresentationMs, mandatory decisions, floor transitions, menus and offline time. Therefore threshold checkpoint (5) can occur only after a combat fixed step, never during failure presentation or diagnosis. Attempted purchases or loadout fixes do not erase elapsed stagnation, and only clearing a new frontier floor or executing Dawn resets it to 0
decisionPolicy.sameCauseDefeatLifecycle: after each defeat compute decisionPolicies.failure.defeatCauseSignature; if it equals run.lastDefeatCauseSignature increment run.sameCauseDefeatCount, otherwise replace the signature and set count to 1; accepted non-Dawn fixes do not clear either value so repeated failure after a fix can reach the threshold; only a floor clear or Dawn clears both
decisionPolicy.manualComparisonCheckpoint: runtime only: after Dawn is unlocked, an explicit open-dawn-comparison command increments system.dawnEvaluationCheckpointOrdinal, evaluates the same reward set, trigger flags and projection against the current stable state, stores a suggestion record {checkpointOrdinal,newRewardIds,projectedReturnImprovement,recommendedAction}, and sets system.lastDawnEvaluationCheckpointOrdinal; it counts one persona.acceptedCommandContactMs, never mutates coins/shards/run/profile, never executes Dawn and never suppresses a later automatic checkpoint. Step-2/3 persona schedules do not auto-open it, so their manual-comparison count is exactly zero unless a test fixture explicitly injects that command
decisionPolicy.projectedReturnImprovementFormula: projected post-Dawn effectivePowerScalar divided by current effectivePowerScalar minus 1
decisionPolicy.projectionProcedure: under clockModel.diagnosticHorizonClockRule, clone the exact pre-Dawn state and snapshot comparisonFloor from comparisonFloorRule; execute dawn.executionOrder through the reset without mutating the source; simulate projectionHorizonForegroundSeconds as one continuous normal foreground segment from F1 using the same build, persona command rules and keyed draws, normal live income, combat, re-clear rewards and purchase checkpoints, with compressed offline re-clear, further Dawn, offline income, unseen floors beyond the pre-Dawn maximum and new random choices disabled. Complete the full local 300000ms wall/foreground horizon regardless of authoritative scenario time or floor-attempt budget already consumed. If an unresolved mandatory shop or relic choice is reached, apply projectionUnresolvedChoiceRule exactly; do not select it, retain a partial floor-clear draft or invent a purchase checkpoint. Evaluate the resulting durable ending clone and original pre-Dawn state against the unchanged explicit comparisonFloor through effectComposition.effectivePowerScalar
decisionPolicy.projectionUnresolvedChoiceRule: this is the sole 300-second Dawn-projection exception for a mandatory shop or relic choice disabled by projectionProcedure. At the first such checkpoint, before drawing or consuming its decision delay, contact or option, require the open transactionDraft owned by clockModel.postClearDraftRevisionRule and discard it atomically to boundaryBaseGameplay: restore the pre-final-batch enemy EHP, party HP, event queue, timers, currentFloor, highest floors, coins and liveIncomeAccruedFraction; remove the final batch, clear/reward/U/unlock/seal/boss/cat/achievement/armament/reconfiguration/purchase deltas, logs, ordinals and contacts; and restore system.stateRevision, committedCombatEventCount and committedEconomyCount exactly. The clone-local diagnosticElapsedWallMs and diagnosticElapsedForegroundMs already consumed before the checkpoint do not rewind. From that durable rollback state freeze combat, floor progress, enemies, helpers, delivery work, choices, unlocks, rewards, Dawn, armament, party and transitions for every remaining complete fixed step; advance the clone gameplay clocks and diagnostic local clocks, accrue only shopModel.liveIncomeAccrual from the boundary-base shop state, and execute no purchase policy because no after-floor-reward evaluation point committed. At the 300000ms endpoint require transactionDraft=null, pendingOfflineEvent=null and frozenForegroundContext=null; purchaseEvaluationOrdinal and both clone-local committed counters equal their boundary-base values. Evaluate ending effectivePowerScalar against decisionPolicy.comparisonFloorRule from this durable income-only endpoint, then discard the clone
decisionPolicy.progressDawnExecutionRule: unlocked and newRewardIds nonempty and at least one trigger true and projected effectivePowerScalar improvement at least minimumProjectedReturnImprovement and persona consent accepts
decisionPolicy.zeroGainRecoveryExecutionRule: unlocked and newRewardIds empty and profile.highestReachedFloor equals profile.lastDawnMaximumFloor, same-cause defeats are at least threshold, no catchup is active for this highestReachedFloor, no prior zero-gain recovery Dawn was executed at this highestReachedFloor, sameMaximumCatchup.eligibility is true, and persona consent accepts. A run that has advanced above lastDawnMaximumFloor without earning a reward ID cannot consume the zero-gain recovery ledger or reset

dawn.firstReturnToPriorMaximumEvaluationProce: for each build independently under returnSchedules.standard and persona.baseline, select the first executed progress Dawn whose newRewardIds is nonempty. Let H be the pre-Dawn profile.highestReachedFloor and priorSeconds be foregroundProgressionSeconds from scenario start through the first floor-clear commit that first set highestReachedFloor to H; include combat, defeat presentation, transitions and required foreground decisions, exclude offline wall time and time after that first H commit. If no qualifying Dawn or no positive finite priorSeconds exists, record positive infinity and fail the scenario. From the exact committed post-Dawn state, create a non-mutating paired diagnostic clone under clockModel.diagnosticHorizonClockRule and run continuous foreground with the same build, persona policy, keyed random stream, purchases, normal choices and combat, while offline settlement/compressed re-clear and every further Dawn are disabled. postSeconds and the local diagnostic clocks start at 0 at the Dawn commit and run through the first floor-clear commit that restores H; reaching a blocking unresolved choice follows the normal choice policy. Use stopPolicy.maximumForegroundSeconds as the exact local inclusive horizon, independent of authoritative scenario time or floor-attempt budget already consumed. Resolve every same-timestamp boundary event under stopPolicy.limitBoundaryRule except that diagnosticHorizonClockRule replaces its authoritative scenario time and attempt operands; restoration at or before the local maximumForegroundSeconds is valid. If H is not restored after that inclusive boundary batch, or any invalid state occurs, postSeconds and the ratio are positive infinity. Otherwise compute postSeconds/priorSeconds per seed. Step 2 uses calibration seeds 1-200 and Step 3 repeats untouched holdout seeds 100000-100999; for each build separately require nearest-rank p50 inside firstReturnToPriorMaximumTimeFractionTarget, report p10/p50/p90 and do not pool builds or drop non-return records

compositeReclearSpeedTargetDerived.formula: prior-run foreground seconds to maximum divided by first post-Dawn foreground seconds to the same maximum

dawn.dawnCountToFloor100Procedure: the measured counter is profile.completedDawnCount, so every executed progress Dawn and every executed zero-gain recovery Dawn counts once; rewardingDawnCount is reported separately and never substitutes for this target. At the atomic F100 success boundary read completedDawnCount after all prior Dawn commits and before any postgame presentation. For each build independently under returnSchedules.standard and persona.baseline, Step 2 calibration seeds and Step 3 untouched holdout seeds report p10/p50/p90; require p10 and p90 inside expectedDawnsToFloor100 inclusive and nearest-rank p50 exactly standardDawnsToFloor100. A non-completing scenario contributes positive infinity and fails rather than being dropped

settlement.hideTransaction: the first of visibilitychange-hidden or pagehide that observes system.pendingOfflineEvent=null is the sole arming transaction. Read preHideRevision=r and one nonnegative safe-integer hiddenAtWallClockUnixMs supplied by clockModel.monotonicClockLifecycle. In authoritative Step 2/3 execution it equals scenario.resultWallElapsedMs at the segment start; in the secondary-branch standard-schedule diagnostic it equals diagnosticWallClockBaseMs+diagnosticElapsedWallMs and neither reads nor mutates authoritative scenario result time. Read hiddenAtMonotonicMs from the active gameplay execution owner under clockModel.gameplayExecutionClockRule. For a blocking-post-clear-boundary this is the byte-exact transactionDraft staged system.monotonicClockMs at the hide timestamp, not the externally visible boundary-base clock; the pending anchor may therefore be later than visible system.monotonicClockMs and is paired with the same hide instant's hiddenAtWallClockUnixMs. Set rollbackQuarantined when the execution owner's system.lastAcceptedWallClockUnixMs is non-null and hiddenAtWallClockUnixMs is below it; diagnostic pending, settlement and high-water updates remain inside the discarded clone. Normally execute uIndex.snapshotCommitRule from the current externally visible state. If contextKind is blocking-post-clear-boundary, instead read the complete staged U snapshot and finite capped commerce multiplier from the byte-exact transactionDraft at the hide timestamp; this includes only subtransactions already staged before the cutoff and never invents the unfinished suffix. Require saveId regex and sequence/clock/revision safe integers; increment monotonicHiddenSequence; construct offlineEventId; atomically persist pendingOfflineEvent exactly as {offlineEventId,hiddenAtMonotonicMs,hiddenAtWallClockUnixMs,hiddenSequence,sourceStateRevision:r+1,rollbackQuarantined,uSnapshot:the selected complete immutable snapshot,commerceMultiplierSnapshot:the selected finite capped multiplier}, the matching frozenForegroundContext with sourceStateRevision=r+1, and stateRevision=r+1 in the same compare-and-swap. Thus pending.sourceStateRevision and context.sourceStateRevision equal the persisted post-hide revision while visible gameplay run/profile and gameplay clocks remain at the boundary-base snapshot. Missing/extra/non-finite/version-mismatched fields fail and arm no credit
settlement.hideAndPagehideCoalescing: if visibilitychange-hidden arms first and pagehide follows, or pagehide arms first and a duplicate hidden callback follows, the later callback validates but preserves the exact pending object, U snapshot, sequence, hidden timestamps, source revision and commerce snapshot and performs no write or revision increment. If pending is non-null for any reason, no hide/pagehide callback may replace it. If pagehide occurs without a preceding hidden callback it runs hideTransaction normally. The sameTimestampOrder visibility-change slot serializes these callbacks after any prior settlement
settlement.offlineEventIdConstruction: exact ASCII `offline|` + system.saveId + `|H` + monotonicHiddenSequence zero-padded to 12 decimal digits + `|T` + monotonicClockMs zero-padded to 16 decimal digits; reject rather than truncate a value wider than its field
settlement.offlineEventId: the immutable ID stored in system.pendingOfflineEvent at hide time; return time is never part of the ID, and reload or retry must reuse the same pending ID
settlement.elapsedSeconds: read returnWallClockUnixMs once. If pending.rollbackQuarantined is true, returnWallClockUnixMs is below pending.hiddenAtWallClockUnixMs, or system.lastAcceptedWallClockUnixMs is non-null and returnWallClockUnixMs is below it, set elapsedSeconds=0 and keep monotonicReturnTimestampMs=system.monotonicClockMs. Otherwise derive monotonicReturnTimestampMs exactly through clockModel.monotonicClockLifecycle and clamp((monotonicReturnTimestampMs-pending.hiddenAtMonotonicMs)/1000,0,capSeconds)
settlement.baseOfflineCoinCalculation: evaluate standardCoinsPerSecondFormulaId from pendingOfflineEvent.uSnapshot.clampedU, then evaluate offlineCoinDeltaFormulaId once from that value, capped elapsedSeconds, baseEfficiency and immutable pendingOfflineEvent.commerceMultiplierSnapshot; no live profile field may replace a pending snapshot value
settlement.incomeAndReclearConcurrency: base offline income always uses the entire capped elapsedSeconds; known-floor re-clear receives a separate budget equal to the same elapsedSeconds and never subtracts from income seconds; its per-floor rewards are summed with baseOfflineCoinCalculation only in credit-one-atomic-total
settlement.atomicCommitRule: at return load expectedRevision=system.stateRevision and the pending object; require pending.sourceStateRevision<=expectedRevision and the same pending ID throughout calculation. The final compare-and-swap requires current revision=expectedRevision and pending ID unchanged; atomically expose coins, internal purchases, re-clear/run ledgers, complete U snapshot and settled ID. On an immediate eligible interval set system.monotonicClockMs=monotonicReturnTimestampMs; under returnSchedules.deferredSettlementClockRule preserve the already advanced current logical clock, which must be at least monotonicReturnTimestampMs, and never assign it backward. In either eligible case set system.lastAcceptedWallClockUnixMs=maximum(previous high-water,returnWallClockUnixMs); on a quarantined interval keep both high-water values unchanged. Then set system.lastCommittedOfflineSequence=pending.hiddenSequence, clear pending and write stateRevision=expectedRevision+1. No intermediate settlement persistence is legal. On CAS failure discard the settlement clone, preserve the durable interruption phase, reload revision and the same pending object and recalculate without rewriting its snapshots or frozen return timestamp input
settlement.crashRecovery: if pending ID is already in profile.settledOfflineEventIds, pay zero and atomically set lastCommittedOfflineSequence=max(current,pending.hiddenSequence), clear pending and increment revision once; if the one compare-and-swap did not add the ID, no credit/purchase/sequence persisted and the same pending object is retried. Always require 0<=lastCommittedOfflineSequence<=monotonicHiddenSequence

uIndex.snapshotCommitRule: after every persistOn trigger, read profile.highestReachedFloor and profile.rewardingDawnCount once; copy policyVersion and the three fixed reference key/value pairs; if highest is 0 set all projected values, median, clamp bounds and clampedU to 0, otherwise evaluate referenceFormulaId once for each fixed reference value, sort projected numeric value then fixed-reference key, take the middle as unclampedMedian, calculate both role-neutral clamp bounds and clamp the median; apply formulaRules.primitiveDefinitions.roundSixDecimals to every derived number. Atomically replace profile.lastPersistedUSnapshot with the complete object in snapshotShape and set profile.lastPersistedU to exactly its clampedU as a read-only compatibility mirror. Partial snapshots and independent scalar writes are forbidden
uIndex.scalarMirrorRule: profile.lastPersistedU is never authoritative and must equal profile.lastPersistedUSnapshot.clampedU after every committed revision; offline settlement consumes only the complete pending uSnapshot

postDawnKnownFloorReclear.progressLedger: run.clearedFloorsThisRun and run.rewardedFloorsThisRun; each is an ascending unique integer set reset only by Dawn
postDawnKnownFloorReclear.missingGuardCandidateRule: ignore null candidates as positive infinity when taking the minimum
postDawnKnownFloorReclear.guardOperandDerivations: previousBest is the source profile.highestReachedFloor before settlement. nextUnresolvedX9 is the smallest absolute n>=run.currentFloor with n<=previousBest, n mod 10=9, and no run.selectedRelicInstances entry whose sourceFloor=n. nextUnselectedChoice is the smallest absolute commercial placement floor n>=run.currentFloor and <=previousBest for which neither run.shopPlacements nor profile.retainedShopBlueprint has that placement floor. nextUnseenBoss is the smallest X0 floor strictly greater than profile.highestReachedFloor, or null when none through F100. All scans use ascending integer floor; absent candidates are null
postDawnKnownFloorReclear.maximumClearableFloorClamp: after null-as-positive-infinity handling, clamp the result to [0,previousBest] and to at most 100; if it is below run.currentFloor no compressed clear occurs
postDawnKnownFloorReclear.currentEffectivePowerOperandRule: immediately before considering each known floor n and before that floor's recovery, reward, retained-blueprint restoration, support restoration or armament-lock decrement, clone the exact committed re-clear source state and evaluate effectComposition.effectivePowerScalar through effectComposition.effectivePowerReferenceTrace with explicit comparison floor n. Preserve every selected named cat's exact current HP from that source state; the reference trace itself removes live helpers, queues and transients. Set runtime.currentEffectivePower to that finite strictly positive scalar. Set runtime.recordedFirstClearEffectivePower to profile.recordedFirstClearEffectivePowerByFloor[String(n)] and fail the scenario if the entry is absent, non-finite or not strictly positive. Set runtime.floorBaseSeconds to bossBaseSeconds exactly when n mod 10 equals 0, otherwise normalBaseSeconds
postDawnKnownFloorReclear.processOrder: begin at the smallest known floor not in run.clearedFloorsThisRun whose lower floors are all already in that set, then process ascending. Compute each duration with secondsFormulaId including minimumSecondsPerFloor, consume only the separate re-clear budget, and clear only if the entire duration fits. The per-floor transaction is exact: apply combatRules.floorClearRecovery once using only effects active before n's clear; add n to clearedFloorsThisRun; if absent add n to rewardedFloorsThisRun and credit rewardFormulaId once; set run.highestFloorThisRun=max(old,n) and run.currentFloor=min(100,n+1); only then restore already-retained shop blueprint and already-known support activation at n; decrement a positive armamentLockRemainingClears once; reset foregroundStagnationMs, sameCauseDefeatCount and lastDefeatCauseSignature. A shop/support restored on n cannot affect n's recovery. Do not change profile.highestReachedFloor, first-clear power, first-clear/boss/event/achievement/decision IDs, cat/shop/armament unlocks, relic choices, armament tier, district seals, Dawn rewards, rewardingDawnCount or deliveryCount. Stop before an unresolved choice or unseen boss
postDawnKnownFloorReclear.partiallyActiveForegroundAttempt: if the exact per-floor transaction clears the currently frozen floor, discard all frozen enemy/projectile/helper/queue/status/timer state and persist the declared next-floor run values; the floorClearRecovery named in processOrder is the single recovery for that clear and is never applied twice. If its full duration does not fit, consume zero partial re-clear time and resume the byte-identical frozen combat state. After all compressed clears, run.currentFloor and run.highestFloorThisRun are the values from the last committed per-floor transaction, or their source values if none committed

offline.acceptanceReferenceSnapshot: for each calibration seed and tested build, clone initialState and run driftMeasurement's exact deterministic continuous replay through the F20 floor-clear commit with Dawn, offline and live income disabled; finish its purchase policy, then normalize run.coins and run.liveIncomeAccruedFraction to 0, set currentFloor 21, retain the resulting unlocked content, placements, profile.highestReachedFloor=20 and recomputed persisted U. Before each explicit case hide, assign clockModel.scenarioIdentityBindings.offlineExplicitCase with that exact caseKey, then hide immediately; returnSchedules.explicitOfflineCases.foregroundBeforeSeconds is measured after this snapshot
offline.acceptancePurchaseCountsStatisticRule: count only single-level upgrade commits made by the one post-settlement purchase-policy loop; over calibration seeds compare p50 for both combat and reinforcement builds to standardEightHours or standardTwentyFourHours, and compare commerce build p50 to commerceTwentyFourHours; report p10 and p90 without threshold, then repeat unchanged on holdout in Step 3
offline.repeatedCycleAnchorRule: run every repeated-cycle case from acceptanceReferenceSnapshot for all three builds and every calibration seed, assigning the exact idempotency, cloned-snapshot or sequential clockModel.scenarioIdentityBindings before each hide; all required equality checks are per seed and build, not aggregates

repeatedCycleCases.idempotency: settle the exact same offline event ID seven times; only the first may pay
repeatedCycleCases.clonedSnapshot: settle seven independently cloned identical snapshots; coin delta and U must be identical
repeatedCycleCases.sequential: advance seven capped intervals with unique event IDs while disabling purchase execution and all progression; every interval must use identical U, commerce snapshot and coin delta

offline.counterfactualAnchorConstruction: for each target boundary B in [10,20,30,40,50,60,70,80], each stage seed and each build, run the normal returnSchedules.standard/persona.baseline scenario from initialState with all ordinary prior Dawn, offline, purchase, choice and combat rules. At B's first legal clear, capture the newly persisted complete post-clear boundary after its purchase loop but immediately before create-and-evaluate-post-clear-dawn-checkpoint; do not suppress or alter any earlier checkpoint. Recompute and persist the complete U snapshot, replace the clone identity with clockModel.scenarioIdentityBindings.counterfactualAnchor for exact B, then arm an exact 24-hour pending offline event. A failure to reach or construct any boundary is an acceptance failure, not a skipped anchor
offline.counterfactualSkipTest: for every counterfactualAnchorConstruction clone settle only baseOfflineCoinCalculation from the exact pending snapshot, set compressed re-clear reward to zero and execute no compressed clears, then run exactly one purchase-policy evaluation to its fixed point. Let start=B+1 and sequentially simulate exactly counterfactualSkipRejectFloors unseen floors through B+20 with authoritative individual-actor atomic combat, normal 90-second deadline, one-hit checks, wave gaps and floorClearRecovery. Carry the selected party unless combatRules.partySelection's normal cat-unlock, Dawn or defeat trigger actually occurs; do not rerank merely on floor entry. Evaluate armament at its normal floor-entry checkpoint. Carry named-cat HP and legal helper lifetime only as normal combat declares; after each counterfactual clear advance only the local probe floor. Disable all coins/live income/rewards/purchases after the initial loop, new unlocks, deliveries, profile/run clear ledgers, first-clear records, choices, reconfiguration, achievements, Dawn and further offline settlement. For each boundary/seed/build, if any floor fails or is incomplete return false and pass that probe; return true and reject the candidate when all 20 exact combats clear legally in order. Every probe must run and no pooling may hide a true result

comparison.completionMetric: wallClockElapsedSeconds from scenario schedule timestamp 0 through the atomic F100 floor-clear commit, including offline segments and foreground decisions; unfinished scenarios are positive infinity
comparison.medianSpreadFormula: for each build take nearest-rank p50 across the 1000 paired holdout-seed completion times under persona.baseline and returnSchedules.standard, then divide the maximum build p50 by the minimum build p50; any incomplete sample remains positive-infinity and infinity divided by infinity fails
comparison.robustSpreadFormula: for each build take nearest-rank p90 and p10 across the same 1000 paired holdout-seed completion times, then divide the maximum build p90 by the minimum build p10; any incomplete sample remains positive-infinity and infinity divided by infinity fails
comparison.extremeSpreadFormula: for each build, on identical returnSchedules.standard segment timestamps, divide nearest-rank p50 completion time across the 1000 paired persona.passive holdout runs by nearest-rank p50 completion time across the corresponding persona.active runs, then take the maximum of the three build ratios; any incomplete median or zero denominator fails
comparison.returnCadenceStressReport: for every build also report active schedule and passive schedule completion distributions without applying the extremeSpread threshold

weapons.normalSwitchLockMeaning: after an accepted routine or defeat-override family change set run.armamentLockRemainingClears to normalSwitchLockFloors; the one accepted F4 tutorial family change sets it to 0. F3 performs only automaticInitialEquipAtUnlock after its clear and has no family-switch evaluation. The tutorial exemption is permanently consumed when floor 4 is added to profile.completedArmamentTutorialFloors, whether or not a switch was recommended; every later F4 evaluation uses routine or defeat rules. Decrement only through combatRules.floorClearProgressCounterCommit; routine changes are blocked while positive; retries and foreground/background transitions do not decrement or reset it
weapons.automaticInitialEquipLockRule: the automatic first equip is not a switch and leaves run.armamentLockRemainingClears at 0

tutorialSwitchExemptions.eligibility: floor-entry evaluation only while 4 is absent from profile.completedArmamentTutorialFloors
tutorialSwitchExemptions.consume: atomically add 4 to profile.completedArmamentTutorialFloors on that evaluation whether the recommendation switches family or keeps the current family
tutorialSwitchExemptions.reason: one lifetime first-reachable matchup comparison after the F3 automatic equip

tier.composition: 1 plus gain times tier; exactly one equipped family receives the tier and threat multipliers

rejection.selectionShareDenominator: all armament-policy selections over weapons.rejection.evaluationProcedure.bossReferenceCorpus's three equally represented roleBalancedThreatVectors; forced family counterfactual clones are not selections
rejection.selectionShareNumerator: role-balanced corpus decisions whose policy-selected family is the tested family
rejection.switchCountEvent: one accepted change from one non-null armament family to another when that family begins affecting a wave or retry; initial automatic equip, tier upgrade, same-family selection, rejected changes, previews, and retry reapplication do not count

evaluationProcedure.stages: run once on calibration seeds 1-200 in Step 2 and unchanged on paired holdout seeds 100000-100999 in Step 3; evaluate each build independently unless a rule explicitly pools families
evaluationProcedure.naturalDecisionCorpus: run the complete standard schedule/persona scenario from initialState to latched F100 success. At every eligible floor-entry or boss-retry decision, before accepting a family, clone the identical state three times and force each unlocked family for that next complete wave/retry; use identical enemy, seed, event keys and command phase and compute authoritative clear/survival, predictedTtkSeconds and armamentRawSurvivalMargin
evaluationProcedure.selectionShareAggregation: for each seed/build run the armament score once on every bossReferenceCorpus X0 state and each of the three equally represented threat vectors, then compute each family's selected count divided by that denominator; a zero denominator fails. For each build/family take nearest-rank p50 across stage seeds and reject when it exceeds maximumSingleFamilySelectionShare; report p10/p50/p90. Natural decision shares are reported separately but are not the balanced-share gate
evaluationProcedure.switchAggregation: count switchCountEvent through F100 per seed/build; for every build require nearest-rank p50 across stage seeds to be within minimumMedianSwitchesToFloor100 and maximumMedianSwitchesToFloor100 inclusive; report p10/p90
evaluationProcedure.bossReferenceCorpus: at the state actually reached immediately before the first attempt of each X0 floor 10 through 100, for every seed/build clone the same recommended party, levels, shops, relics, tier, HP, enemy total EHP/attack/events and command phase for all three families and all three roleBalancedThreatVectors; replace only phase threat shares with the selected vector in every phase, retain phase EHP shares and all boss mechanics, and simulate one exact attempt without purchases/rewards/unlocks/Dawn
evaluationProcedure.bossBandAggregation: for each stage/build/class pool every assigned predictedTtkSeconds sample across its seeds, X0 floors, families and vectors without filtering; an incomplete/non-finite attempt is positive-infinity. Compare nearest-rank p50 to weapons.bossTtkBandsSeconds[class] inclusive and report p10/p90; an infinite p50 or empty class fails
evaluationProcedure.recommendedNaturalBossTtkAggregation: for each stage/build pool the policy-selected predictedTtkSeconds at the first natural attempt of X0 floors 10-100 across all stage seeds without filtering; incomplete is positive-infinity. Require nearest-rank p50 within recommendedSelectedX0BossTtkSeconds inclusive, report p10/p90, and fail an empty or infinite-p50 cohort
evaluationProcedure.universalFastestPredicate: in each bossReferenceCorpus state/vector sample consider only authoritative surviving families; if none survive consider all three. A family is unique fastest when its finite TTK is lower than every other considered family by more than comparisonEpsilon. Reject if, within any stage/build, one same family is unique fastest in all three vectors at every X0 state and seed; ties are not unique fastest
evaluationProcedure.paretoRule: on each mixed-vector boss state, family A dominates B when A TTK <= B TTK+comparisonEpsilon and A armamentRawSurvivalMargin >= B margin-comparisonEpsilon with at least one strict improvement beyond epsilon. Count a sample as tradeoff-preserving when at least two families are nondominated and Guardian has strictly greater raw survival margin than at least one family with strictly lower TTK
evaluationProcedure.mixedTradeoffAggregation: for each build compute the fraction of all mixed-vector stage seed/X0 states satisfying paretoRule and require it >= mixedTradeoffMinimumPassingShare in both stages; zero samples fail
evaluationProcedure.rawSurvivalSignCalibration: for every forced family sample in bossReferenceCorpus, positive full-condition armamentRawSurvivalMargin predicts every selected named cat is alive in the matching normalized-full-HP replay at its diagnostic horizon and zero/negative predicts at least one KO; compare only with that normalized outcome, count either sign inversion, and for each stage/build/family require mismatches/total <= maximumRawSurvivalSignMismatchShare. Zero samples, a non-finite margin or an exact zero treated inconsistently fail; report false-positive and false-negative counts separately. State-faithful damaged-party survival remains the primary armament decision outcome and is reported separately
evaluationProcedure.stateFaithfulSurvivalCalibration: for every unlocked family forced clone at every naturalDecisionCorpus checkpoint, use effectComposition.armamentRawSurvivalProcedure's exact source-current-HP diagnostic horizon. Compare the displayed armamentDecisionSurvivalOutcome with whether at least one selected named cat is alive at that exact horizon in the matching authoritative replay, after separately enforcing oneHitCheck. Predicted pass with exact no-survivor or predicted fail with an exact survivor is one sign inversion; missing, non-finite or inconsistent horizons fail. Each build must have zero inversions under maximumStateFaithfulSurvivalSignInversions in calibration and holdout. This is separate from normalized-full-HP rawSurvivalSignCalibration
evaluationProcedure.displayedTtkDirectionEvaluation: at every naturalDecisionCorpus checkpoint with a non-null current family, compare every different unlocked candidate shown by the UI using the same-state forced clones. Let predictedDelta=current predictedTtkSeconds minus candidate predictedTtkSeconds and exactDelta=current exact one-attempt clear time minus candidate exact one-attempt clear time, with failure/incomplete equal to positive-infinity. A displayed direction inversion occurs when both deltas are finite and exceed comparisonEpsilon in opposite directions; missing clones, infinity-minus-infinity or a finite prediction paired with no exact outcome fail. Each build must have zero displayed inversions under maximumDisplayedTtkDirectionInversions
evaluationProcedure.recommendationDirectionEvaluation: for every accepted or suggested family change, including tutorial and defeat overrides, require the candidate's exact attempt to improve clear time by more than comparisonEpsilon whenever the displayed predictedDelta is positive; exact failure, tie or regression is one recommendation inversion. Also count an inversion when the recommendation claims a fail-to-survive to survive change but the exact candidate has no survivor while the exact current clone has one. The stricter recommendation gate is evaluated in addition to displayedTtkDirectionEvaluation and stateFaithfulSurvivalCalibration
evaluationProcedure.recommendationDirectionAggregation: sum all three prediction-versus-measurement inversion classes over every natural checkpoint, seed and build separately in calibration and holdout; each build must independently satisfy maximumDisplayedTtkDirectionInversions, maximumStateFaithfulSurvivalSignInversions and maximumRecommendationDirectionInversions, report the offending floor, seed, current family and candidate family, and fail a zero-checkpoint corpus
evaluationProcedure.sameStateGuarantee: every counterfactual family/vector clone differs only in the explicitly forced family and threat vector; recommended state, total EHP, attack, event schedule, seed, source ordinals and command phase are byte-identical. A mutation outside those fields invalidates the sample

purchase.purchaseReferenceFloorRule: bind exactly one explicit integer comparisonFloor before incrementing purchaseEvaluationOrdinal and use it unchanged for every control/candidate clone and every iteration in that evaluation loop. At after-floor-reward-and-unlocks, comparisonFloor=minimum(100,clearedFloor+1), where clearedFloor is the floor owned by the current floorClearCommitOrder draft; do not read the still-untransitioned run.currentFloor. At after-offline-settlement, comparisonFloor equals the staged settlement clone's resulting run.currentFloor after every compressed re-clear and before its purchase loop; it must be 1 through 100. At after-defeat-diagnosis, comparisonFloor equals the immutable failure diagnosis failedFloor, which must equal the retry-prepared run.currentFloor before any suggested change. Pass this explicit comparisonFloor to effectComposition.utilityCategoryEvaluationRule and effectivePowerReferenceFloorRule for both before/after endpoints. A nested diagnostic/projection replay uses the same rule for the legal evaluation point it is emulating; no caller fallback may substitute source run.currentFloor, profile.highestReachedFloor or a later transition floor
purchase.evaluationOrdinalRule: at the start of each evaluation point increment system.purchaseEvaluationOrdinal exactly once; every candidate in that evaluation uses the same resulting ordinal, including after sorting, and previews never increment it
candidateOptions: one level for each profile-unlocked cat
one level for each placed shop instance
purchase.candidateKeyConstruction: cat upgrade is `cat|`+cat canonical ID+`|to|`+target level zero-padded to 4 digits; shared helper is `helper|shared|to|`+target level zero-padded to 4 digits; shop upgrade is `shop|`+shop canonical ID+`|floor|`+placement floor zero-padded to 3 digits+`|to|`+target level zero-padded to 4 digits; these ASCII keys are used for purchase-noise keys and final ties and are not registry IDs
purchase.purchaseUtilityOperandRule: for every legal candidate at the current evaluation iteration, freeze one identical pre-candidate state after all prior committed purchases in this loop. Bind the evaluation's explicit comparisonFloor only through purchaseReferenceFloorRule. Set runtime.buildWeights exactly to candidate.builds[scenario build key].purchaseUtilityWeights. Set runtime.categoryBefore to effectComposition.utilityCategoryEvaluationRule's four values on that pre-candidate control and runtime.categoryAfter to its four values after exactly the candidate's one-level transaction clone at that same explicit comparisonFloor. Evaluate waitSecondsForCostFormulaId with runtime.cost equal to that candidate's exact next-level cost, runtime.currentCoins equal to the pre-candidate run.coins before reserve filtering or cost deduction, and runtime.liveIncome equal to the pre-candidate fully composed foreground live coins per second; use the resulting finite nonnegative value as runtime.waitSeconds. An already affordable cost therefore has waitSeconds=0. Pass exactly these operands to utilityFormulaId, then apply purchaseUtilityNoiseApplication once to the raw utility. Never use post-purchase coins/income, a different build's weights, reserve-adjusted coins or a category value from another candidate
purchase.purchaseUtilityNoiseApplication: multiply final utility by 1 plus the keyed scenario purchase-noise draw whose entity key is exactly candidateKeyConstruction and whose ordinal is system.purchaseEvaluationOrdinal
purchase.eligibilityAndRankingRule: score and log every legal nonmax candidate, but normal selection filters first to candidates satisfying affordableWithReserveRule and finite utility strictly greater than 0, then applies selectionOrder; an unaffordable higher score never blocks a lower affordable candidate. When that filtered set is empty, every evaluation point buys nothing except that the after-defeat-diagnosis point alone may test defeatEmergencyReserveOverride below
purchase.defeatEmergencyReserveOverride: only when the current evaluation point is after-defeat-diagnosis and no positive candidate is affordable with reserve, allow exactly one highest-positive candidate whose cost is <= currentCoins; after-floor-reward-and-unlocks and after-offline-settlement never use this override
purchase.selectionOrder: highest utility, then greatest absolute effectivePowerScalar gain, then lowest cost, then candidateKeyConstruction lexicographically
purchase.transaction: deduct exact cost, increment exactly one level, recompute all effects through effectComposition.maximumHpMutationRule and U, log before and after, then reevaluate candidates. A purchase inside floorClearCommitOrder stages its economy count, ordinal, level/effect/U mutation and log under clockModel.postClearDraftRevisionRule with no individual stateRevision increment; a standalone stable-checkpoint purchase owns one compare-and-swap
purchase.bulkRule: UI bulk is equivalent to an ordered sequence of exact single-level prices with no discount; it commits all or none and never changes candidate ordering

shopReconfiguration.availability: available after a commercial placement has been cleared and committed; it is paid before that placement's district boss is cleared in the current run and free from that clear until the next Dawn reset
evaluationCheckpoints: once after a district-boss floorClearCommit opens that run's free period and before transition
once when decisionPolicies.failure.concreteChangeEvaluationOrder reaches shop-reconfigure-if-unlocked after all earlier categories reject
shopReconfiguration.evaluationPointRule: at each listed checkpoint enumerate, rank and commit at most one transition, then stop; it is never evaluated after ordinary purchases, floor entry, offline settlement, nonboss floor clear or elsewhere, and runtime manual viewing does not add a simulation checkpoint
shopReconfiguration.freePeriodRule: the district boss floor being present in run.clearedFloorsThisRun is the sole free-period flag; a profile first-clear flag alone does not make later runs free
shopReconfiguration.affordabilityRule: before that run clear, require run.coins >= preBossCostFormulaId for the placement floor and deduct that exact amount on commit; during the free period the cost is postBossCostCoins
shopReconfiguration.scope: shop placements on already cleared commercial floors in that district only
shopReconfiguration.candidateTransitions: enumerate replacing exactly one placement's shop ID with every currently unlocked shop ID, including duplicates but excluding an unchanged ID; the candidate placement level becomes 0, so every current-run level on that placement is lost, while its floor blueprint slot remains; recompute duplicate and adjacency effects
shopReconfiguration.selection: enumerate and log every candidate transition with its placement-specific applicable cost, evaluate each with effectComposition.boundedDecisionProjectionProcedure and effectComposition.choiceScoreRule, then filter to candidates whose score is strictly positive and finite and whose cost is <= current run.coins. Rank only that affordable filtered set by greatest score, then greatest candidate effectivePowerScalar minus control effectivePowerScalar, then earlier selected-build shopPreference rank, then lowest placement floor, then canonical shop ID; an unaffordable higher-scoring transition never blocks a lower-scoring affordable transition. If the filtered set is empty, commit no change
shopReconfiguration.commit: atomically deduct the exact applicable cost, replace the placement shop ID, set that placement level to 0, recompute all effects using effectComposition.maximumHpMutationRule, update the same floor in profile.retainedShopBlueprint, immediately commit achievement.first-shop-synergy if its trigger becomes true, and log the lost level and retained blueprint before and after. A post-boss floorClearCommitOrder evaluation stages the change and economy count under clockModel.postClearDraftRevisionRule with no individual stateRevision increment; a defeat-policy standalone evaluation owns one compare-and-swap

armament.evaluationCheckpoints: evaluate once immediately before every floor's first wave starts and once after every defeat diagnosis when failure policy reaches armament-change; never switch during a wave or boss phase
armament.score: first separate options whose effectComposition.armamentRawSurvivalProcedure armamentDecisionSurvivalOutcome passes; among passing options choose lowest finite predictedTtkSeconds, then greatest armamentRawSurvivalMargin, then greatest survivalMarginScalar, then canonical armament ID. If none pass, choose greatest armamentRawSurvivalMargin, then greatest survivalMarginScalar, then lowest finite predicted TTK, then canonical ID
armament.routineAcceptance: outside tutorial and defeat overrides, require run.armamentLockRemainingClears=0 and routineTtkImprovementFormula at least weapons.minimumPredictedTtkImprovementForRoutineSwitch; if current armamentDecisionSurvivalOutcome fails and the candidate passes, bypass only the TTK threshold but not the lock. A candidate with the same pass/fail outcome must not claim a defensive improvement unless armamentRawSurvivalMargin is strictly greater; reject any non-finite comparison
armament.overrideAcceptance: the floor 4 tutorial exemption bypasses lock and TTK threshold only at floor entry while 4 is absent from profile.completedArmamentTutorialFloors; F3 is automatic equip only and is not a switch evaluation. Once 4 is recorded, every later F4 pre-wave evaluation uses routine rules, including after Dawn. After a defeat, weapons.defeatOverrideAllowsImmediateSwitch bypasses lock and TTK threshold only for a candidate with strictly greater armamentRawSurvivalMargin or an authoritative fail-to-survive to survive change
armament.acceptedFamilyChangeCommit: evaluation occurs only in a stable pre-wave or pre-retry checkpoint, so an accepted choice changes run.equippedArmament to the selected unlocked family before that next wave initializes; no active attack/event is rewritten. If old is null, this is only weapons.automaticInitialEquipAtUnlock during the F3 post-clear unlock: set the family, leave lock 0, emit no switch event/contact/achievement pending, stage it under clockModel.postClearDraftRevisionRule and persist only with that F3 boundary. At the one eligible F4 tutorial evaluation, atomically add 4 to profile.completedArmamentTutorialFloors whether the recommended family equals old or differs. If it equals old, commit only that consumed marker and emit no switch event, armament contact or pending achievement. If two non-null families differ, classify the already-authorized source as routine, one-time F4 tutorial or defeat override; emit exactly one weapons.rejection.switchCountEvent, count one personas.decisionContactRule armament contact, set lock to normalSwitchLockFloors for routine/defeat or 0 for tutorial, and set run.pendingArmamentSwitchAchievementFamily to selected unless achievement.first-armament-switch is complete. The one-time F4 tutorial is a standalone pre-F4-wave floor-entry commit after the F3 transition has carried the already-selected party and evaluated the F4 armament, and before the F4 floor-entry Dawn checkpoint; it never belongs to an F3 or F4 floorClearCommitOrder draft. Every F4 tutorial marker commit and every two-non-null change persists all fields in one standalone stateRevision compare-and-swap. The selected family first affects the immediately following wave or retry; if that floor-entry Dawn executes next, dawn.reset retains the matching pending family and retained equipped family until the first successful new-run wave commits the achievement. CAS failure discards the choice and reevaluates from fresh state; a later accepted family change replaces the pending achievement family. rewardLedger.achievementCommitBoundaryRule remains the only achievement success commit
armament.floorEightDisclosedTargetRule: at F8 wave-3 entry unconditionally freeze attempt.f8NamedTargetMode to ledger-first; this is an encounter rule, not an armament forecast. It performs no predicted-survival test and every reference or utility trace uses the same frozen targeting rule

diagnosisPredicates.atomic-one-hit: survival.oneHitCheck rejects at least one selected named cat in the attempt-start snapshot
diagnosisPredicates.frontline-collapse: at failure at least one selected named cat has frontlineShare >= combatRules.partyRequiredFrontlineShareThreshold and every such selected cat is KO
diagnosisPredicates.anti-air-deficit: current wave or phase began with positive flying EHP and its remaining/initial EHP ratio is strictly greater than both armor and neutral ratios, treating an absent bucket as -1
diagnosisPredicates.armor-deficit: current wave or phase began with positive armor EHP and its remaining/initial EHP ratio is strictly greater than both flying and neutral ratios, treating an absent bucket as -1
diagnosisPredicates.backline-targeting-deficit: the first selected named-cat KO selected by combatRules.koEventIdentityRule had frontlineShare below partyRequiredFrontlineShareThreshold and that KO's provenanceDamageEventIds contains at least one immutable enemy-projectile delivery
diagnosisPredicates.healing-deficit: at least one selected named-cat KO satisfies healingDeficitCounterfactualRule
diagnosisPredicates.damage-deficit: the attempt ended by the 90-second limit with positive enemy EHP, or every selected named cat is KO and no earlier diagnosis predicate is true

failure.healingDeficitCounterfactualRule: for each selected named-cat KO, take the immutable event-queue and actor snapshot after all earlier simultaneousEventOrder categories at the fatal timestamp but immediately before commit-same-timestamp-deltas. Consider only interval-heal triggers already present in that snapshot with concrete due d satisfying koTimestampMs<d<=koTimestampMs+1000; the lower endpoint is exclusive and upper endpoint inclusive. Ignore cancellation caused solely by this target's KO or the resulting attempt failure, but require the heal source to remain alive after the fatal commit and require every other source/status prerequisite already armed in the snapshot. Do not forecast later damage, expiry, wave clear or newly scheduled triggers. For lowest-ratio-heal only, counterfactually keep the KO actor target-eligible at ratio 0 while every other actor uses its post-fatal-commit ratio, then apply the normal canonical-ID tie-break; it counts only if that exact actor is selected. A periodic-party-heal counts for the KO actor because its party target includes each counterfactually target-eligible named cat. Exclude Toto wave heal, nap-inn wave recovery, floorClearRecovery and any heal lacking an already queued interval due timestamp. The predicate is true if any one qualifying trigger exists; inspect KO actors by koEventIdentityRule's timestamp/event-ID/actor-key order

failure.partyChangeRule: at the clean retry checkpoint after combatRules.retryState, compare the current party with the different canonical-ID list returned by combatRules.partySelection using combatRules.partySelectionEvaluationRule on the same failed run.currentFloor, current equipped armament, shops, support, relics, tier, HP assignment, identical keyed stream and effectComposition.effectivePowerReferenceTrace. Fixture boss then replays F1-F9 in foreground with authoritative combat, the normal post-clear purchase policy and every blocking choice, commits a newly selected F9 relic normally, uses scheduleKey=reclearBoss and hides at F10; it never retains a pre-Dawn relic or fabricates a choice. survival.authoritativeModel: individual actor HP and atomic damage events under combatRules; pooled HP is forbidden for pass/fail
survival.successRule: last enemy EHP reaches zero at or before 90000ms while at least one selected named cat is alive and every mandatory one-hit check passes
survival.failureRule: all selected named cats are KO, positive final enemy EHP remains after the exact-90000ms damage/KO/clear commit, a non-finite value appears, or a mandatory one-hit check fails
survival.mandatoryOneHitGateTiming: for every floor attempt, after floorAttemptStart has incremented its ordinal, initialized HP/transients/timers and captured the exact selected party, equipped armament, reachable variant/phase and composed always-on effects, run survival.oneHitCheck at local combat t=0 before scheduling or resolving any melee, projectile, helper, caster, telegraph, heal or live-income fixed step. If every class passes and run.pendingInitialTutorialGuard=true, first materialize exactly the forced guard through helperBaselines.autoDispatch.initialTutorialTapRule, clear that flag and anchor the first ordinary automatic dispatch one effective interval later; only then schedule normal combat from t=0. If every class passes with the flag false, schedule normal combat normally. If any class fails, record the exact actor/class/value as a mandatory rejection, mark this already-counted attempt failed at t=0 with combatSeconds=0, create no helper request, helper spawn or combat event ID, leave all three ordinals at zero, preserve pendingInitialTutorialGuard unchanged, advance no combat or income tick, and enter combatRules.failureBoundaryOrder; later retry improvements cannot erase the recorded rejection, and the zero-tolerance acceptance gate still fails the candidate
survival.oneHitCheck: for every selected named cat and every tested floor variant/phase, independently compose that phase's authoritative full maximum HP and always-on mitigation, then apply the largest possible atomic event from each class that can authoritatively occur there: normal melee, normal projectile, elite heavy and boss heavy. Do not synthesize an absent class; test every reachable variant and every boss phase and use the largest event in each present class. Normally include active shop, support and equipped-armament effects. For F100 phase 3, apply floorOverrides.100.fourPhaseMechanics.phaseThreeShopLockdown before this composition: exclude every shop-derived maximum-HP and mitigation field, compose shop-free full HP, and calculate shop-free incoming damage for every present phase-3 class. Never reuse another phase's shop-active HP or mitigation. Assume zero conditional shield, Mugi shield, helper guard or frontline-guard charges even if one is armed in a live trace, and reject when any tested event leaves zero or less HP
survival.conditionalMitigationRule: mandatory one-hit acceptance is the worst-case uncharged test above, while actual combat and survivalMarginScalar consume any legally armed conditional charge in simultaneousEventOrder; a charged live event may improve survival but can never excuse a failed static one-hit gate
survival.burstCheck: also sum different event IDs whose impact timestamps differ by at most 100ms and record burst KO separately; this never changes the atomic one-hit definition
survival.recommendedBandDefinition: the exact levels and legal party reached by the same persona, schedule, build and purchase policy at the tested floor without debug grants
survival.recommendedBandEvaluationProcedure: in both calibration and holdout stages, for each build under standard schedule/persona capture recommendedBandDefinition immediately before the first natural attempt of every reached floor. For every selected named cat and every reachable floor variant/phase, use survival.oneHitCheck's exact phase-authoritative maximum-HP and mitigation composition, including its F100 phase-3 shop-free lockdown exception, then calculate full-HP hits-to-KO as ceiling(composed maximumHp / largest present post-always-on-mitigation atomic normal event), with conditional shields/charges absent; never reuse the pre-attempt shop-active composition for a shop-locked phase. Classify frontlineShare>=partyRequiredFrontlineShareThreshold as frontliner and the rest as backliner. For each build and absolute floor, pool actor/variant samples across stage seeds separately by class and require nearest-rank p50 of every nonempty frontliner cohort within enemyModel.recommendedBandSurvival.frontlinerNormalHitsToKoRange and every nonempty backliner cohort within backlinerNormalHitsToKoRange. Require at least one backliner cohort by F4 or fail, because Luna is first available only after the F3 post-clear unlock. On every X0 boss phase compute the largest unavoidable boss-heavy damage divided by each phase-authoritative full-HP frontliner's maximumHp; for each build/floor/phase require nearest-rank p50 across seeds/actors within bossUnavoidableHeavyHitFrontlinerMaxHpFractionRange. Empty required cohorts, incomplete runs and non-finite values fail; report p10/p50/p90 and one-hit failures separately

prng.name: xorshift32-keyed-one-draw
