entityKeyConstruction.absoluteFloor: ASCII `floor|F` plus absolute floor zero-padded to 3 digits; ordinal 0
entityKeyConstruction.firstTimeDecision: ASCII `decision|F` plus absolute floor zero-padded to 3 digits plus `|first`; ordinal 0
entityKeyConstruction.laterCommercialDecision: ASCII `decision|F` plus absolute floor zero-padded to 3 digits plus `|commercial`; ordinal 0
entityKeyConstruction.laterRelicDecision: ASCII `decision|F` plus absolute floor zero-padded to 3 digits plus `|relic`; ordinal 0
entityKeyConstruction.encodingRule: UTF-8 with no whitespace, locale formatting, JSON serialization, normalization, prefix substitution or trailing newline; every declared key above is exact

seedPolicy.preHoldoutDiagnosticSeedRule: before Step 3, every seeded scenario, fixture, probe and diagnostic must use only calibrationSeedsInclusive; drawing any other seed is a fatal exposure and requires Step 1 re-seal with a holdout range disjoint from that exposed seed and all lifecycle-ledger history
seedPolicy.holdoutRangeDisjointRule: holdoutCommonSeedsInclusive must not intersect calibrationSeedsInclusive; Step 3 preflight must also reject intersection with every observed, finalized or unresolved inclusive seed range anywhere in the lifecycle ledger regardless of bankId, while an exactly adjacent non-overlapping range is permitted

holdoutReusePolicy.observationDefinition: the bank becomes observed when any seed-level result, aggregate statistic, acceptance verdict or diagnostic derived from one or more bank seeds is materialized outside the running process
holdoutReusePolicy.acceptanceVerdictValidityRule: a verdict is valid only when one immutable candidate raw digest and one immutable simulator raw digest produced the exact 3000 expected build-by-seed scenario identities, every seed-level record passes the sealed result schema with no missing or duplicate identity, aggregate values are independently recomputed from that exact raw dataset, and one acceptance record containing the dataset, summary and verdict digests is finalized exactly once

expectedScenarioIdentityContract.enumerationRule: enumerate every build in holdoutBuilds order and, within each build, every integer seed from the inclusive start through end in ascending order, producing exactly the object {build,seed} with fields in identityFieldOrder and no other field
expectedScenarioIdentityContract.preimageRule: UTF-8 JSON.stringify of the exact 3000-element identity array with no whitespace, BOM or trailing LF

lifecycleLedgerContract.valueDomainRule: sequence, seed bounds, expectedScenarioCount and exposedDerivedOutputCount are safe nonnegative integers; every Sha256 field is 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; attemptId matches ^holdout-bank-[0-9]{3}-attempt-[0-9]{6}$; eventAt is canonical UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ; failureCode is infrastructure-zero-derived-output; firstOutputKind is one of seed-record, aggregate, diagnostic or verdict; verdict is PASS or FAIL; bank identity, candidate digest, simulator digest and Step 2 seal digest remain byte-identical throughout one attempt
lifecycleLedgerContract.canonicalizationRule: select the record type's exactFields except recordSha256, require those fields and no others, then create a new object by taking present names in canonicalPayloadFieldOrder order; encode exactly UTF-8 JSON.stringify of that object with no whitespace, BOM or trailing LF; all strings are already restricted by valueDomainRule so no implementation-specific normalization is allowed
lifecycleLedgerContract.recordHashPayloadRule: recordSha256 is excluded from its own payload and equals lowercase SHA-256 of the exact canonical payload bytes; previousRecordSha256 remains included in that payload
lifecycleLedgerContract.physicalLineRule: the physical record is UTF-8 JSON.stringify of a new object containing the canonical payload fields in order followed by recordSha256 as the final field, then exactly one LF; blank lines, CR, BOM, duplicate keys, alternate key order, whitespace and an unterminated last line are invalid
lifecycleLedgerContract.previousLinkRule: the first record has sequence=1 and previousRecordSha256=genesisPreviousRecordSha256; each later record has sequence exactly prior sequence+1 and previousRecordSha256 exactly equal to the immediately prior record's recordSha256, never a raw-line digest
lifecycleLedgerContract.ledgerRevisionRule: the compare-and-append revision is lowercase SHA-256 of all current raw ledger bytes; an absent or zero-byte ledger has emptyLedgerRevisionSha256; an append must atomically compare the previously read revision and replace it with exactly prior bytes plus one validated physicalLineRule record
lifecycleLedgerContract.concurrencyRule: preflight and the CONSUMPTION_STARTED append form one exclusive compare-and-append transaction using ledgerRevisionRule; a concurrent start or revision mismatch fails before any holdout draw
lifecycleLedgerContract.preflightRule: before the first holdout draw, validate every historical record and scan the entire ledger across all bank IDs; reject if the requested inclusive seed range intersects any range with OUTPUT_OBSERVED or VERDICT_FINALIZED, intersects any unresolved CONSUMPTION_STARTED range, reassigns a historical bankId to different bounds, or assigns any historical bounds to another bankId; allow retry of the exact same bank identity only after its matching NO_OUTPUT_INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE proves zero derived outputs were exposed and candidateRawSha256, simulatorRawSha256 and step2ExecutableSealRawSha256 are unchanged; adjacent non-overlapping ranges are disjoint and allowed
lifecycleLedgerContract.startRule: append CONSUMPTION_STARTED before the first holdout draw with its exact record contract; candidateRawSha256 equals the preflighted candidate raw digest, simulatorRawSha256 equals the Step 2 executable seal simulatorSourceTreeSha256, step2ExecutableSealRawSha256 equals the raw seal file digest, expectedScenarioIdentitySha256 follows expectedScenarioIdentityContract, expectedScenarioCount=3000 and eventAt is the append timestamp; the candidate is immutable for the entire attempt
lifecycleLedgerContract.observationRule: append exactly one OUTPUT_OBSERVED atomically no later than the first external materialization of any seed-derived value with exposedDerivedOutputCount>=1; that record spends the entire bank while allowing only the same registered consumption session to finish
lifecycleLedgerContract.verdictRule: append exactly one VERDICT_FINALIZED after strict validation of all 3000 identities and independent aggregate recomputation, recording rawDatasetSha256, summarySha256, acceptanceSha256 and verdict
lifecycleLedgerContract.crashRule: after OUTPUT_OBSERVED, any crash, partial dataset, invalid dataset or missing valid verdict permanently bars that bank from promotion and invokes partialMaterializationWithoutValidVerdictAction
lifecycleLedgerContract.tamperRule: deletion, rewrite, truncation, broken sequence or hash link, duplicate record type within an attempt, duplicate finalization, bankId reassignment, overlapping observed or unresolved seed range, identity mismatch or non-append mutation is a fatal acceptance failure

executionPowerMultiplier.appliesTo: all outgoing damage events after deterministic effects

scenarioVariance.compositionExceptionRule: for absolute F1 and F8 disable both armorShareShift and flyingShareShift for every wave and use zero shifts while still applying executionPowerMultiplier. driftMeasurement.purpose: measure adjacent-district structural pressure independently of Dawn and return schedules
driftMeasurement.probeFloorMapping: for lower district d and relative index r, F=(d-1)*10+r and comparison floor is F+10; r=10 is the district boss
driftMeasurement.variance: disabled; execution multiplier 1 and purchase noise 0
driftMeasurement.schedule: continuous foreground replay with no Dawn, no offline income, no live shop income and zero first-time/later-choice decision delay. Still commit every mapped action in its canonical order at zero duration: at drift t=0 execute the F1 tutorial tap, unlock auto-dispatch, set pendingInitialTutorialGuard and start A1; after A1's mandatory one-hit gate passes materialize its sole forced guard and anchor commands/ordinary auto-dispatch exactly as helperBaselines.autoDispatch.initialTutorialTapRule declares. On later floors commit required shop/relic/disclosure records and contacts are recorded as zero for this diagnostic. Add each reached floor to completedFirstTimeDecisionFloors only after its action commits. Inside effectComposition.boundedDecisionProjectionProcedure this no-live-income override remains authoritative
driftMeasurement.anchorState: create entry(F) by cloning initialState and replaying each absolute floor n=1 through F-1 with the exact deterministic combat and event stream, execution multiplier 1 and purchase noise 0; for every n, run combat to a legal clear, then perform floorClearCommitOrder—including scripted deliveries, objective events, only condition-satisfied cat unlocks, deterministic shop/relic choices, tiers, seals and its one run-post-clear-purchase-policy loop—before advancing. That embedded loop is the only purchase evaluation; never call purchase policy a second time. Never grant a cat merely because its listed floor was reached; F1 uses initialState exactly; any failed replay makes the probe invalid
driftMeasurement.referenceThreat: evaluate anchor, coin-only exit and total exit against the exact role and threat composition of F+10
driftMeasurement.coinOnlyExit: clone entry(F), then for n=F through F+9 in ascending order atomically credit n's floor-clear reward exactly once, suppress every unlock, support, placement, relic, armament-tier, seal, event and first-clear side effect from n, run purchases to the normal fixed point using only cats and shop placements already present at entry(F), and set the probe floor to n+1; never bulk-credit rewards; the result after n=F+9 is coinOnlyEntry(F+10) before combat or reward
driftMeasurement.totalExit: clone entry(F), then for n=F through F+9 in ascending order replay n's exact deterministic combat and floorClearCommitOrder under the same schedule, commit only actually satisfied events and conditional unlocks, make every deterministic choice, and use only that order's one embedded run-post-clear-purchase-policy loop before advancing; never invoke a second purchase evaluation or bulk-credit rewards. The result is totalEntry(F+10) before combat or reward
driftMeasurement.districtPurchaseEffectivePowerMultiplier: effectivePower(coinOnlyEntry(F+10), referenceThreat(F+10)) divided by effectivePower(entry(F), referenceThreat(F+10))
driftMeasurement.districtPersistentAndUnlockPowerMultipli: effectivePower(totalEntry(F+10), referenceThreat(F+10)) divided by effectivePower(coinOnlyEntry(F+10), referenceThreat(F+10))
driftMeasurement.d10Pre: enemy EHP at F+10 divided by enemy EHP at F, then divided by districtPurchaseEffectivePowerMultiplier
driftMeasurement.invalidProbe: any non-finite value, unaffordable negative state, or missing unlock is a candidate failure

d10Pre.comparison: entry(F) to entry(F+10), both before that floor's combat and reward, at the same relative floor

acceptance.driftAcceptanceAggregation: evaluate all 9 district pairs times 10 relative-floor probes times 3 builds = 270 deterministic probe values with variance disabled. acceptance.activeToPassiveThreeMinuteProcedure: under clockModel.diagnosticHorizonClockRule, for each build and calibration seed clone initialState twice, run exactly the first 180 foreground seconds of the standard schedule with segment timestamps unchanged and override only command/decision behavior with persona.active versus persona.passive. If a clone reaches F100 early, apply activeToPassiveEarlyTerminalRule; any other incomplete/error clone fails its pair. At the endpoint set comparisonFloor=min(100,max(active.profile.highestReachedFloor,passive.profile.highestReachedFloor)+1), pass that explicit floor to both effectivePowerReferenceTrace calls, and divide active effectivePowerScalar by passive effectivePowerScalar. Each build's paired-seed p50 must lie in activeToPassiveThreeMinuteEffectivePowerRatioOnStandardSchedule and p10/p90 are reported; Step 3 repeats on holdout without tuning
acceptance.activeToPassiveEarlyTerminalRule: this defensive rule applies only if either active/passive diagnostic clone atomically latches valid F100 success before diagnosticElapsedForegroundMs=180000. Capture its byte-exact terminal gameplay snapshot and completion timestamp under stopPolicy.floor100TerminalRule, requiring pendingOfflineEvent=null, frozenForegroundContext=null and transactionDraft=null. Freeze every run, profile and system field, gameplay clock, completion metric, coin, U, level, HP, event, counter, ordinal and revision; schedule and mutate no income, combat, event, purchase, Dawn, transition, hide, return, settlement or postgame action. Advance only that clone's diagnosticElapsedWallMs and diagnosticElapsedForegroundMs through the remaining first-standard-foreground milliseconds until each equals exactly 180000, then compute its finite endpoint effectivePowerScalar from the frozen terminal state. The paired nonterminal clone continues normally to the same local horizon; neither source clone nor the other pair member is altered
acceptance.acceptanceAggregationRule: every build-level threshold is evaluated independently unless its field explicitly defines a cross-build ratio. Use a per-seed ratio before percentiles only when that metric's own formula explicitly says per-seed; builds.comparison medianSpreadFormula, robustSpreadFormula and extremeSpreadFormula instead use their declared ratios of nearest-rank percentiles and are the controlling exceptions. Nearest-rank rounding applies, and any positive-infinity scenario causes completion-rate failure rather than being dropped
